Heroes.Innate Ability: Oathbound — The first time each Round an allied Hero in your Location gains Guarded or recovers Health, Seraphine gains Guarded. Aura of Resolve — While Seraphine is Guarded, the first harmful Status Effect that would be applied each Round to another Hero in her Location is ignored. Sacred Stand — Once per Quest, spend 1 Action. Seraphine and each other Hero in her Location recover 2 Health, gain Guarded, and remove 1 harmful Status Effect. Consecrated Bulwark — While Seraphine is Guarded, the first time each Round another Hero in her Location suffers damage from an Enemy Attack, reduce that damage by 2, minimum 0. Oath Eternal — Once per Quest, spend 1 Action. Until the start of Seraphine's next turn, Heroes in her Location gain Guarded, cannot gain harmful Status Effects, and cannot be reduced below 1 Health by Enemy Attacks. Sanctified Vanguard — Once per Round after Seraphine gains Guarded, choose another Hero in her Location; that Hero gains Guarded until the end of their next turn. Immortal Oath — Once per Quest when any Hero in Seraphine's Location would be Defeated, prevent that defeat, set that Hero to 3 Health, remove one harmful Status Effect from them, and Seraphine suffers 2 unavoidable damage. At the start of Seraphine's turn, one ally in her Location may gain Guarded or remove Frightened/Marked.

Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one: 1) Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. 2) Reveal one unrevealed Location connected to your Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Victory favors those who understand the battlefield before the battle begins.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Veteran's Resolve
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one: 1) Recover 1 discarded Hero Deck card and add it to your hand. 2) Remove one Condition affecting you.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Experience is measured not by the battles won, but by the resolve to stand again.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Last Bastion
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Until the start of your next turn: You increase your armor by 2. Other Heroes in your Location gain Inspired. Whenever another Hero in your Location would suffer damage from an Enemy Attack, you may suffer that damage instead. If you prevent damage this way, draw 1 card. (Limit once per Attack.)
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: If this is where we make our stand... then none shall pass.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Heroic Charge
Hero Deck Cards.Target: Yourself and up to 2 Allied Heroes
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose yourself and up to 2 allied Heroes in your Location. Move all chosen Heroes to the same connected Location. Then: Each chosen Hero gains Inspired until the start of your next turn. You may immediately make a basic Attack against an Enemy in that Location. One other chosen Hero may immediately make a basic Attack against an Enemy in that Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: With me! Today we reclaim this ground!

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Quick Strike
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack. If the Attack defeats the target, draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: One clean strike is worth a hundred wild swings.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Backstab
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack. If you have Stealth, this Attack gains +2 Attack. After this Attack resolves, lose Stealth.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The deadliest blade is the one never seen.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Expose Weakness
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack. If the Attack deals damage, the target gains Exposed until the end of your next turn.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Armor always has a seam. You simply have to find it.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Twin Blades
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one: 1) Make 2 basic Attacks against the same Enemy. The second Attack suffers -1 Attack. 2) Make 1 basic Attack against each of up to 2 different Enemies in your Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: One blade distracts. The other finishes.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Shadow Ambush
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: You may only play this card while you have Stealth. Make a basic Attack with +3 Attack. If this Attack defeats the target: Draw 1 card. You may immediately move to a connected Location. After this Attack resolves, lose Stealth.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The perfect ambush leaves only silence behind.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Throwing Knife
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack against an Enemy in a connected Location. If the target has Exposed, this Attack gains +1.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Distance is only another angle of attack.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Evasive Maneuver
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when an Enemy declares an Attack against you. Choose one: 1) Gain +2 armor against this Attack. 2) Move to a connected Location. If moving causes the attacking Enemy to no longer be able to target you, the Attack immediately ends.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: You can't hit what isn't there.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Smoke Bomb
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when you are targeted by an Enemy Attack. Gain Stealth. The attacking Enemy suffers -2 Attack for this Attack. You may move to a connected Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: By the time the smoke clears, she's already gone.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Feint
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play after an Enemy Attack against you deals 0 damage. Choose one: 1) Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. 2) The attacking Enemy gains Exposed.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Sometimes the greatest victory is convincing your opponent they've already won.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Uncanny Reflexes
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when you are targeted by an Enemy Attack. Choose one: 1) Gain Stealth. 2) After that Attack resolves, immediately make a basic Attack against the attacking Enemy if it is a valid target.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Their mistake becomes your opportunity.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Acrobatic Escape
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play after you suffer damage from an Enemy Attack. Reduce that damage by 1. Then choose one: 1) Move to a connected Location. 2) Gain Stealth.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every fall is another chance to disappear.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Scout Ahead
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one: 1) Reveal one unrevealed Location connected to your Location. 2) Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. If you have Stealth, you may do both instead.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Knowing where the enemy waits is half the battle.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Create Opening
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose an Enemy in your Location. That Enemy gains Exposed. If you have Stealth, draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: They never notice the mistake until it's too late.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Shadow Signal
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: If you have Stealth, reveal yourself. Until the start of your next turn: Allied Heroes gain +1 attack when attacking an Exposed Enemy. The first allied Hero that defeats an Exposed Enemy this round draws 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: One signal from the shadows, and everyone knows exactly where to strike.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Shadowstep
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected Location. Then choose one: 1) Gain Stealth. 2) Draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A single step into darkness can change the entire battle.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Hit and Run
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack against an Enemy in your Location. After the Attack resolves, you may move to a connected Location. If the Attack defeated the target, gain Stealth.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Strike. Vanish. Leave only questions behind.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Wall Runner
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move up to 2 connected Locations. You may ignore Difficult Terrain and other terrain-based movement restrictions while moving this way. If you end this movement in a Location with no Enemies, gain Stealth.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Where others see walls, Lyra sees another path.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Thieves' Tools
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one: 1) Disarm a Trap in your Location. 2) Unlock a Locked object in your Location. 3) Gain 2 Insight toward an Objective in your Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every lock has a key. Sometimes it's just a matter of making one.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Case the Area
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one: 1) Reveal up to 2 connected Locations. 2) Look at the top 3 cards of the Encounter Deck. Return them in any order. If you have Stealth, you may choose both instead.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every escape route. Every guard. Every weakness. Know them before the first step.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Death from the Shadows
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: You may only play this card while you have Stealth. Make a basic Attack with +4 Attack. If the target is Exposed, this Attack also gains +1 attack. If the Attack defeats the target: Draw 1 card. Gain Stealth. You may move to a connected Location. After this Attack resolves, lose Stealth unless you regained it from this card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: They never knew I was there. They never knew I was gone.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Vanish Without a Trace
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when an Enemy Attack is declared against you or when an Enemy enters your Location. Immediately: Gain Stealth. Move to a connected Location. End the triggering Enemy's Attack or movement against you. Until the start of your next turn, you cannot be chosen as the target of Enemy Attacks.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: When they finally realize she's gone... it's already too late.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Radiant Strike
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack. If the target is Undead or Cursed, this Attack gains +1 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The Light answers every blow struck in defense of the innocent.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Sacred Flame
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack against an Enemy in a connected Location.If this Attack deals damage, choose one Hero in your Location or the target's Location. That Hero recovers 1 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Mercy for the faithful. Fire for the wicked.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Purifying Smite
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack. If this Attack deals damage, choose one: 1) Remove one Condition from an allied Hero in your Location. 2) If the target is Undead or Cursed, this Attack gains +1 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Corruption cannot survive the touch of true faith.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Consecrated Blow
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack. If this Attack deals damage, your Location becomes Consecrated until the start of your next turn. Consecrated: The first time each Hero in this Location would recover Health each round, they recover 1 additional Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Where the hammer falls, sacred ground rises.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Judgment of the Faithful
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack. If this Attack deals damage, choose one allied Hero in your Location. That Hero gains Inspired. If the target is Undead or Cursed, draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The Light does not simply punish evil—it strengthens those who stand against it.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Beacon of Hope
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack. If this Attack deals damage: Your Location becomes Consecrated until the start of your next turn. Up to 2 allied Heroes in your Location recover 1 Health. If the target is Undead or Cursed, each healed Hero may also remove one Condition.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Where hope shines brightest, darkness cannot endure.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Divine Shield
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when a Hero in your Location is declared the target of an Enemy Attack. That Hero gains +2 armor against this Attack. If the Hero suffers no damage from this Attack, they recover 1 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Faith is the shield that no blade can pierce.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Guardian's Blessing
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when a Hero in your Location or a connected Location would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2. If all damage is prevented, that Hero gains Inspired.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The Light reaches even those beyond my sight.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Sanctuary
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when an Enemy ability or Attack would affect two or more allied Heroes in your Location. Until the end of the current Attack or ability: Allied Heroes in your Location gain +1 armor. Your Location becomes Consecrated until the start of your next turn.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Stand together, and the Light shall shelter you all.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Intercession
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when a Hero in your Location or a connected Location would be defeated. Instead, that Hero remains at 1 Health. Remove all Conditions from that Hero. That Hero cannot recover Health until the end of the current Enemy turn.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Your journey is not yet over.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Aegis of the Dawn
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when an Enemy Attack or ability would affect one or more allied Heroes in your Location. Until the end of the current Attack or ability: Allied Heroes in your Location cannot have their Health reduced below 1. Your Location becomes Consecrated until the start of your next turn. After this effect resolves, each protected Hero recovers 1 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: When dawn breaks, despair yields to hope.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Bless
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose up to 2 allied Heroes in your Location. Each chosen Hero gains Inspired. If your Location is Consecrated, draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: May your hands be steady, your heart unwavering, and your spirit filled with ...

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Prayer of Restoration
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose up to 2 allied Heroes in your Location. Each chosen Hero chooses one: 1) Recovers 1 Health 2) Removes one Condition. If your Location is Consecrated, one chosen Hero may both recover 1 Health and remove one Condition.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Healing begins with faith, but true restoration renews both body and spirit.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Divine Communion
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose all allied Heroes in your Location. Each chosen Hero chooses one: 1) Recover 2 Health. 2) Remove one Condition. 3) Gain Inspired. If your Location is Consecrated, each chosen Hero may choose two different options instead.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Together, we are stronger than darkness. Together, we endure.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Guided Path
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected Location. Choose one: 1) Recover 1 Health. 2)Remove one Condition from yourself. If you move into a Consecrated Location, draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The Light always reveals the way forward.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Shepherd the Faithful
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one allied Hero in your Location. 1) You and the chosen Hero each move to the same connected Location. 2) After moving, one of you recovers 1 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: No soul walks alone beneath the Light.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Wings of Mercy
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to any connected Location, ignoring enemy movement restrictions. After moving, choose one: 1) One allied Hero in your Location recovers 2 Health. 2) Remove one Condition from each allied Hero in your Location. Your Location becomes Consecrated until the start of your next turn.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Where suffering calls, the Light arrives.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Holy Insight
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one: 1) Reveal all face-down tokens in your Location. 2) Gain 2 Insight toward the current Objective. If your Location is Consecrated, draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The Light reveals what darkness seeks to hide.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Rite of Purification
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text:
Choose one: 1) Remove one negative Location Effect from your Location. 2) Remove one Trap or Hazard in your Location. 3) Gain 2 Insight toward the current Objective.
If your Location is Consecrated, you may choose two different options instead.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: No corruption can endure where the Light is welcomed.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Divine Intervention
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when an allied Hero would be defeated. Instead: That Hero remains at 1 Health. Remove all Conditions from that Hero. Move Sister Elara to that Hero's Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The Light has not finished with you.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Light of Ascendance
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose all allied Heroes in your Location. Each chosen Hero: Recovers 2 Health. Removes one Condition. Gains Inspired.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Stand together in the Light, and no darkness shall overcome you.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Arcane Bolt
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack against an enemy in your Location or a connected Location. If you are in an Arcane Location, this Attack gains +1 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Even the simplest spell becomes extraordinary in the hands of a master.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Arcane Missile
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack. This Attack gains +1 attack. If you are in an Arcane Location, after this Attack resolves, you may choose another enemy in your Location or a connected Location. Deal 1 damage to the chosen enemy.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: One spell is a threat. A master makes it many.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Frost Nova
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose up to 3 enemies in your Location. Each chosen enemy suffers a basic Attack. After resolving these Attacks, choose one enemy damaged by this card. Move that enemy to a connected Location of your choice. If you are in an Arcane Location, you may instead move up to two damaged enemies.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The bitter cold stills both blade and courage.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Arcane Surge
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make a basic Attack. If this Attack deals damage, choose one: 1) Deal 1 damage to another enemy in the target's Location. 2) Push the target to a connected Location. If you are in an Arcane Location, you may choose both options instead.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Power is not measured by destruction, but by control.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Gravity Well
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose a Location within range. Move up to 2 enemies from connected Locations into the chosen Location. Then make a basic Attack against each enemy moved this way. If the chosen Location is an Arcane Location, those Attacks gain +1 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The stars themselves answer my command.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Meteor Shard
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose a Location within range and up to 3 enemies there. Each chosen enemy suffers a basic Attack. If you are in an Arcane Location, each enemy damaged by this card gains Burning. Burning: At the start of that enemy's next activation, it suffers 1 damage, then remove Burning.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A fragment of the heavens is more than enough.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Arcane Barrier
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when a Hero in your Location is declared the target of an Enemy Attack. That Hero gains +2 armor against this Attack. If you are in an Arcane Location, the attacking enemy suffers 1 damage after the Attack resolves.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every spell cast against me strengthens my resolve.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Blink
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when you are declared the target of an Enemy Attack. Move to a connected Location. If the Attack is no longer valid, it immediately ends. If you move into an Arcane Location, draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A wise wizard knows that the best defense is simply not being there.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Spell Reflection
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when a Hero in your Location or a connected Location is targeted by an Enemy ability or Spell. Cancel that ability or Spell unless its source pays 1 additional Action. If it cannot, the ability or Spell is canceled. If the canceled ability or Spell targeted only one Hero and you are in an Arcane Location, deal 2 damage to its source.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Magic is a conversation. I simply choose the final word.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Phase Shift
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when you would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2. You may then move to a connected Location. If you move into an Arcane Location, recover 1 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The body is merely another state of matter.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Temporal Stasis
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when a Hero in your Location or a connected Location would be defeated. That Hero cannot be reduced below 1 Health by the triggering Attack or ability. Remove that Hero from the battlefield. Return that Hero to their previous Location at the start of your next turn with 1 Health. If you are in an Arcane Location, that Hero also draws 1 card when they return.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: For but a heartbeat, time itself stands still.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Arcane Intellect
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose yourself or one allied Hero in your Location. That Hero draws 2 cards, then discards 1 card. If you are in an Arcane Location, the chosen Hero does not discard a card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Knowledge gained at the right moment is more valuable than any blade.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Arcane Infusion
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one allied Hero in your Location. Until the end of that Hero's next turn, the first Attack card they play gains +1 Attack. If you are in an Arcane Location, that Hero also gains Inspired.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Magic does not replace skill—it elevates it.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Leyline Convergence
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose all allied Heroes in your Location. Until the start of your next turn, the first Hero card each chosen Hero plays costs 1 fewer Action (minimum 1). Your Location becomes an Arcane Location until the start of your next turn. If your Location is already an Arcane Location, each chosen Hero draws 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: When every thread of magic is woven together, the impossible becomes inevitable.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Teleport
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to any connected Location, ignoring enemy movement restrictions. If you move into an Arcane Location, draw 1 card. Otherwise, you may create an Arcane Location in your new Location until the start of your next turn.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Distance is merely a limitation of ordinary minds.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Dimension Door
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose yourself and one allied Hero in your Location. Move both Heroes to the same connected Location. This movement ignores enemy movement restrictions. If the destination is an Arcane Location, each moved Hero recovers 1 Health. Otherwise, the destination becomes an Arcane Location until the start of your next turn.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The shortest path is the one that ignores reality.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Ethereal Passage
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to any Location within 2 connections, ignoring all enemy movement restrictions and hazards. You do not trigger enemy abilities or effects caused by movement during this move. If you end this movement in an Arcane Location, recover 1 Health and draw 1 card. Otherwise, create an Arcane Location in your destination until the start of your next turn.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: For a fleeting moment, the world becomes little more than mist.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Detect Magic
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Look at the top three cards of the Equipment Deck and return them in any order. If you are at an arcane location return one to the bottom of the equipment deck.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The currents of fate leave traces for those who know where to look.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Arcane Ward
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one Location. Place an Arcane Ward token in that Location. While an Arcane Ward is present: That Location is treated as an Arcane Location. The first enemy that enters that Location each round suffers 2 damage. Remove the Arcane Ward after it triggers 3 times. Only one Arcane Ward may exist at a time. If you create a new Arcane Ward, remove the previous one.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every step toward me is a step through my magic.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Time Stop
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Until the start of your next turn:	Enemies cannot Move or play Reaction abilities. The first Attack played by each allied Hero this round gains +1 Attack. You may immediately play 1 additional Hero card without spending an Action. If you begin this spell while in an Arcane Location, draw 2 cards after resolving this card. Limit 1 per campaign.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: For one impossible moment, the world obeys only my will.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Arcane Cataclysm
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose up to 3 Locations. Each enemy in the chosen Locations suffers an Attack with +3 Attack. After resolving all Attacks: Push each damaged enemy to a connected Location of your choice. Each chosen Location becomes an Arcane Location until the end of the encounter. If a chosen Location was already an Arcane Location, each allied Hero there recovers 2 Health and draws 1 card. Limit 1 per campaign.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The battlefield itself becomes my spell.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Hunter's Shot
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. If the target is Marked, draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every hunt begins with patience.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Quick Shot
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections with -1 Attack. You may play this card before or after a Move during your turn.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Speed wins where strength cannot.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Pinning Arrow
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. If the attack deals damage, the target gains Rooted until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Stand still.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Longbow Volley
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make one Attack against each Enemy in your Location. Resolve each Attack separately.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A storm of arrows darkened the sky.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Armor Piercer
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. Ignore 2 Armor when resolving this Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Even steel has weak points.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Ricochet Arrow
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack against one Enemy within 3 connections. If it deals damage, immediately make a basic Attack against a second Enemy within 1 connection of the first target.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: One arrow. Two chances.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Predator's Mark
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one Enemy within 3 connections. It becomes Marked until the end of the round. Attacks against it gain +1 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Nothing escapes my sight.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Rain of Arrows
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one revealed Location within 3 connections. Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy in that Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The forest itself turned against them.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Set Snare
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Place a Snare token in a connected revealed Location. The first Enemy entering that Location suffers 2 damage and gains Rooted; then remove the token.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A careless step ends the hunt.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Camouflage
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Gain Hidden until the start of your next turn. Hidden ends early if you Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The woods hide those who respect them.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Beast Lore
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one Enemy in your Location. Until the end of the round, allied Heroes gain +1 Attack against it.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every creature leaves a weakness behind.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Eagle Eye
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Look at the top 3 cards of the Exploration Deck and return them in any order.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The horizon tells stories to those who look.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Scout Ahead
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Reveal one connected unrevealed Location without spending an Explore Action. Resolve its Reveal Effect normally.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: I'll make sure the path is clear.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Trailblazer
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one Hero in your Location. That Hero may immediately Move to a connected revealed Location without spending an Action, if not Engaged.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Stay close.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Swift Advance
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move up to 2 connected revealed Locations. The first time this movement would leave Difficult Terrain, ignore its additional Move requirement.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Never stay where the enemy expects.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Grappling Hook
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected revealed Location, ignoring one movement restriction caused by terrain or an Enemy effect. If you end with no Enemy in your Location, draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Height is an advantage.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Overwatch
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when an Enemy enters a Location within 3 connections that Rowan can target. Immediately make a basic Attack against that Enemy before it completes its activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Not one step further.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Dodge Roll
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when Rowan is targeted by an Attack. Gain Guarded until that Attack is resolved.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Too slow.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Master's Hunt
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against a Marked Enemy within 3 connections. Ignore all Armor. If it is Defeated, you may immediately play one Attack card without paying its Action Cost.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The hunt ends now.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Arrow Storm
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one revealed Location within 3 connections. Make an Attack with +2 Attack against every Enemy there. After resolving, each surviving Enemy becomes Marked until the end of the round.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The sky vanished beneath a rain of arrows.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Blessed Strike
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. If this Attack Defeats the target, one other Hero in your Location recovers 1 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Mercy follows justice.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Shield Bash
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location. If it deals damage, the target gains Stunned until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Stand down.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Smite Evil
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +1 Attack if the target damaged a Hero this round.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Your crimes are remembered.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Cleansing Blow
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Remove one harmful Status from yourself or another Hero in your Location, then make an Attack against one Enemy in your Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Light burns corruption away.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Divine Smite
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. Against an Undead, Demon, or Corrupted Enemy, ignore all Armor.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: No darkness endures forever.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Hammer of Judgment
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If it deals damage, move the target to a connected Location if legal.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Judgment has weight.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Holy Retribution

Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy in your Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: If they are all standing close, that is their mistake.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Headlong Charge
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected revealed Location containing an Enemy. Make an Attack with +3 Attack against one Enemy there.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The shortest path is straight through them.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: No Mercy
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +4 Attack against one Enemy that has a harmful Status Effect.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Weakness is an invitation.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Battle Roar
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Until the end of Garruk's turn, his Attacks gain +1 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Hear that? That is your courage leaving.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Feed the Rage
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Suffer 1 damage. Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Pain goes in. Violence comes out.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Ignore the Pain
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when Garruk would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2, minimum 0.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: I have had worse.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Too Angry to Fall
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when Garruk would be reduced to 0 Health. He remains at 1 Health instead. Limit 1 per Quest.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Death can wait its turn.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Warpath
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected revealed Location. If an Enemy is there, Garruk's next Attack this turn gains +1 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every step brings me closer to something worth hitting.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Break Free
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Remove Stunned, Rooted, or Weakened from Garruk.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Chains, roots, fear—break them all.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Challenge the Strongest
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one Enemy in Garruk's Location. It gains Marked by Garruk until the end of its next activation. Garruk's next Attack against it gains +2 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: You. The big one. Come here.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Blood for Blood
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play after an Enemy in Garruk's Location damages him. Make a basic Attack against that Enemy.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Hit me once. See what it costs.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Berserker Frenzy
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against each Enemy in Garruk's Location. Garruk suffers 1 damage after all Attacks resolve.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: When the rage takes hold, everyone nearby pays.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Avatar of Rage
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Until the end of Garruk's next turn, his Attacks gain +3 Attack and he cannot be reduced below 1 Health. Limit 1 per Quest.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: For one glorious moment, fury wears a human shape.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Shadow Bolt
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Darkness needs no invitation.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Hexing Blast
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack. If it deals damage, the target gains Weakened until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The wound is only the beginning.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Marked for Ruin
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. The target gains Marked until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: I have already seen how this ends.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Agonizing Curse
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +3 Attack. If the target already has a harmful Status Effect, gain +2 additional Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Pain is much more useful when it lingers.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Withering Ray
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If it deals damage, the target gains Weakened.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Strength fades quickly under the right whisper.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Cursed Chain
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against up to two Enemies in the same Location. Each damaged target gains Marked.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Misery spreads best when shared.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Soul Rend
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +3 Attack. If the target has a harmful Status Effect and is defeated, recover 1 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: What breaks the body can still nourish the soul.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Black Flame
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose a Location within 2 connections. Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy there. Afflicted Enemies take +1 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Shadow burns colder than fire—and longer.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Curse of Frailty
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: One Enemy within 2 connections gains Weakened until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Stand tall. It makes the fall more satisfying.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Doom Mark
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: One Enemy within 2 connections gains Marked until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: There. Now fate knows where to find you.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Spread the Misery
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose an afflicted Enemy and another Enemy in the same Location. Copy one harmful Status Effect from the first to the second.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Why should only one of you suffer?

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Dark Bargain
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Suffer 1 damage. Draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every secret has a price. Blood is simply convenient.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Shadow Step
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected revealed Location, ignoring Engagement during this movement.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The dark between footsteps belongs to me.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Warding Hex
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when an Enemy within 2 connections declares an Attack. That Enemy gains Weakened for the triggering Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Strike if you wish. You will regret the attempt.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Soul Shield
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when Veyra would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2. If the source has a harmful Status Effect, reduce it by 3 instead.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Let their corruption blunt the blade.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Cruel Insight
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. If an Enemy in Veyra's Location is afflicted, do not discard.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Pain has always been an excellent teacher.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Malefic Echo
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play after an afflicted Enemy removes a harmful Status Effect. Reapply that Status Effect until the end of its current activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Some curses refuse to die when told.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Harvest Despair
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one afflicted Enemy within 2 connections. Veyra recovers 1 Health and her next Attack against it this turn gains +1 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Fear ripens quickly in the doomed.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Plague of Curses
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one Location within 2 connections. Each Enemy there gains Weakened and Marked until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: One whisper becomes a chorus of ruin.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Damnation
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each afflicted Enemy within 2 connections. Limit 1 per Quest.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: I do not condemn them. I simply make the sentence inevitable.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Grave Bolt
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The dead still remember how to reach for the living.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Bone Spear
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. This Attack ignores 1 Armor.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Bone keeps its edge long after flesh forgets.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Deathly Touch
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against one Enemy in Mordren's Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Life is a fragile habit.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Grave Burst
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose a Location within 2 connections. Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy there.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A grave need not stay quiet.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Servant Assault
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose a Bone Servant in Mordren's Location. It deals 2 damage to one Enemy there.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Even the smallest corpse can still be useful.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Bone Legion
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Each Bone Servant deals 2 damage to one Enemy in its Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Obedience improves remarkably after death.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Corpse Explosion
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Remove one Bone Servant. Make an Attack with +3 Attack against each Enemy in that Servant's Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Waste nothing.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Life Drain
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If it deals damage, Mordren recovers 1 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Your last breath will serve me better.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Raise Bone Servant
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Place a Bone Servant in Mordren's Location, up to his maximum.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Stand. Your work is not finished.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Grave March
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected revealed Location. One Bone Servant in Mordren's previous Location may move with him.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The dead do not tire, complain, or turn back.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Sacrificial Power
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Remove one Bone Servant. Mordren's next Attack this turn gains +4 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: One servant spent. A dozen enemies regretted.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Bone Shield
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when Mordren would suffer damage. Remove a Bone Servant in his Location to reduce that damage by 4, minimum 0.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The dead are remarkably loyal shields.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Dead Interpose
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when a Hero in a Location containing a Bone Servant would suffer damage. Remove that Servant and reduce the damage by 3, minimum 0.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A corpse has little left to lose.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Grave Recall
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move one Bone Servant within 2 connections to Mordren's Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Come back. I have not dismissed you.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Harvest Essence
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Remove one Bone Servant. Draw 2 cards and recover 1 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Even ruin contains something worth taking.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Death's Patience
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Until the end of Mordren's turn, the first time an Enemy is defeated within 2 connections, place a Bone Servant in that Location, up to his maximum.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every battlefield eventually supplies its own army.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Grasping Dead
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: One Enemy within 2 connections gains Rooted until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The earth remembers every hand buried beneath it.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Command the Fallen
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play after an Enemy enters a Location containing a Bone Servant. That Servant deals 2 damage to the Enemy.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: You heard me. Kill.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Army of Bones
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Place a Bone Servant in Mordren's Location and each connected revealed Location, up to his maximum.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: One grave is a tragedy. A hundred are reinforcements.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Death Unbound
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Each Bone Servant deals 3 damage to one Enemy in its Location. Then Mordren may remove any number of Bone Servants; for each removed this way, draw 1 card or recover 1 Health. Limit 1 per Quest.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: At last, the dead are given purpose without restraint.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Quick Thrust
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy in Lucien's Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A gentleman never wastes the opening.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Lunging Strike
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected revealed Location, then make a basic Attack against one Enemy there.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Distance is merely an inconvenience.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Duelist's Cut
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack. If the target is the only Enemy in Lucien's Location, gain +3 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: One opponent is all I need.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Flashing Blades
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against up to two different Enemies in Lucien's Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Do try to keep up.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Riposte
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play after an Enemy Attack against Lucien deals 0 damage. Make a basic Attack against that Enemy if it is a valid target.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Your mistake was assuming I had finished.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Passing Strike
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +1 Attack. After it resolves, Lucien may Move to a connected revealed Location if able.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Why stay where the danger expects you?

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Precision Lunge
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +4 Attack against one Enemy in Lucien's Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: There is always one perfect line.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Flourish
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack. If it deals damage, the target gains Marked by Lucien until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Style is not necessary. It is simply deserved.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Dashing Assault
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected revealed Location. Make an Attack with +3 Attack against one Enemy there. Lucien may then Move back to his previous Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Arrive, strike, leave—before they understand the first part.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Finishing Thrust
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If the target is at half its Maximum Health or less, gain +2 additional Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A duel should never overstay its welcome.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Fancy Footwork
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected revealed Location, ignoring Engagement during this movement.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: If they can predict your feet, they have already predicted your blade.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Vault
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move up to 2 connected revealed Locations. Lucien cannot end this movement in his starting Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Walls are suggestions with poor imagination.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: En Garde
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when Lucien is targeted by an Enemy Attack. Reduce damage from that Attack by 2, minimum 0.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: At least try to make this interesting.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Sidestep
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when Lucien is targeted by an Enemy Attack. Move to a connected revealed Location. If the Attack is no longer valid, it ends.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: You aimed where I was. How charming.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Taunting Salute
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one Enemy in Lucien's Location. It gains Marked by Lucien until the end of its next activation. Lucien's next Attack against it this turn gains +1 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Come now. Surely you can do better than that.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Opening Found
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Lucien's next melee Attack this turn gains +2 Attack. If he Moved this turn, draw 1 card after that Attack resolves.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every defense has a seam. Mine is noticing it first.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Second Wind
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Lucien recovers 2 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: I refuse to look exhausted in front of an audience.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Acrobatic Escape
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play after Lucien suffers damage. Move to a connected revealed Location if able.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A graceful retreat is still graceful.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Master Duelist
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one Enemy in Lucien's Location. Until the end of his turn, Lucien's Attacks against it gain +2 Attack. After each such Attack, he may Move to a connected revealed Location and back without spending Actions.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: For this moment, the rest of the battlefield does not exist.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Perfect Finale
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move through up to 2 connected revealed Locations. During this movement, make one Attack with +3 Attack against up to 3 different Enemies you enter a Location with. Limit 1 per Quest.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Every performance deserves an ending worth remembering.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Spirit Bolt
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The ancestors speak softly. Their anger does not.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Storm Spirit
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Thunder answers those who remember its name.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Thorn Spirit
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack. If it deals damage, the target gains Rooted until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The earth holds fast when the spirits command it.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Spirit Flame
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +3 Attack against one Enemy within 2 connections.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Not every sacred fire gives warmth.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Totemic Strike
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack. If Asha's Spirit Totem is in her Location, this Attack gains +2 Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A spirit beside you makes every blow heavier.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Thunder Circle
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy in Asha's Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Stand within the circle and hear the sky answer.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Ancestral Wrath
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Make an Attack with +2 Attack. If a Hero in the target's Location has a beneficial Status Effect, gain +1 additional Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Blessings can sharpen into vengeance.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Call the Storm
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Choose one Location within 2 connections. Make an Attack with +1 Attack against each Enemy there.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The sky is never empty. It is only waiting.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Place Spirit Totem
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Place a Spirit Totem in Asha's Location, up to her maximum.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A place becomes sacred when the spirits choose to remain.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Healing Spirit
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: One Hero in Asha's Location recovers 2 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The old ones remember how the body was meant to be.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Ancestor's Blessing
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: One Hero in Asha's Location gains Inspired until the end of their next turn.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Walk with those who walked before you.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Cleansing Smoke
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Remove one harmful Status Effect from a Hero in Asha's Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Let the smoke carry away what does not belong.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Spirit Walk
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move to a connected revealed Location. If it contains Asha's Spirit Totem, draw 1 card.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Where the totem stands, the path is already known.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Totem Recall
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Move one of Asha's Spirit Totems within 2 connections to Asha's Location.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: No spirit is ever truly far away.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Protective Ancestor
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when a Hero in Asha's Location would suffer damage. Reduce that damage by 2, minimum 0.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: A hand unseen can still catch the blow.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Spirit Warning
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Play when a Hero in Asha's Location or a connected Location is targeted by an Enemy Attack. That Hero gains +1 Armor for the triggering Attack.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: Listen closely. The spirits warn before they strike.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Totemic Pulse
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Asha and each Hero in a Location containing one of her Spirit Totems recover 1 Health.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: One heartbeat, carried through every sacred place.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Spirit Snare
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: One Enemy within 2 connections gains Rooted until the end of its next activation.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The living run. The earth remembers.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Grand Totem
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Place a Spirit Totem in Asha's Location, even if this temporarily exceeds her maximum by 1. Heroes there gain Inspired until the end of their next turn.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: When many voices gather, even the battlefield must listen.

Hero Deck Cards.Name: Call of the Ancestors
Hero Deck Cards.Rules Text: Heroes in Asha's Location and each connected revealed Location recover 2 Health and gain Inspired until the end of their next turn. Enemies there gain Weakened until the end of their next activation. Limit 1 per Quest.
Hero Deck Cards.Flavor Text: The ancestors do not return for glory. They return because we called.

Equipment.Name: Rusted Shortsword
Equipment.Ability 1: Worn Edge — first attack each encounter gains +1 attack.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Its blade is chipped and stained with rust, but in desperate hands it can still draw blood.

Equipment.Name: Iron Shortsword
Equipment.Ability 1: Quick Strike — once per turn after defeating an Enemy, move 1 space/Location-equivalent without reactions.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Balanced for speed rather than brute force, the iron shortsword is favored by scouts and skirmishers.

Equipment.Name: Iron Longsword
Equipment.Ability 1: Parry — once per round when hit by melee attack, reduce damage by 1.
Equipment.Flavor Text: The trusted weapon of soldiers and adventurers alike, built to endure years of hard fighting.

Equipment.Name: Steel Longsword
Equipment.Ability 1: Riposte — once per round after successfully defending against melee attack, immediately make a free melee attack.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Forged from superior steel, this blade is prized by knights for its balance and resilience.

Equipment.Name: Knight's Longsword
Equipment.Ability 1: Defender of the Realm — while with at least one allied Hero, gain +1 armor.
Equipment.Ability 2: Hold the Line — once per encounter, when allied Hero in your Location would suffer damage, you may become target instead.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Forged for the kingdom's finest champions, every nick in its polished blade tells the story of a life defended.

Equipment.Name: Flaming Longsword
Equipment.Ability 1: Blazing Strike — once each turn when you deal damage, deal +1 Fire Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Ignite — once per encounter, after an Attack with this weapon deals 4 or more Damage to an Enemy, that Enemy gains Burning.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Its blade burns without fuel, leaving trails of embers with every swing.

Equipment.Name: Vampiric Longsword
Equipment.Ability 1: Life Drain — first time each turn you deal damage, recover 1 Health.
Equipment.Ability 2: Blood Hunger — if target is defeated, gain +1 Attack until end of next turn.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Forged through forbidden rituals, the blade thirsts for the life essence of those it strikes.

Equipment.Name: Dragonsteel Longsword
Equipment.Ability 1: Dragon's Might — ignore 2 Armor when dealing damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Legendary Blade — once per encounter, when declaring an Attack with this weapon, declare Dragon Strike. That Attack gains +3 Attack and ignores all Armor.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Forged in dragonfire and cooled in the blood of an ancient wyrm.

Equipment.Name: Defender's Bastard Sword
Equipment.Ability 1: Versatile Grip — one-handed: +1 armor while shield equipped; two-handed: +1 Damage on melee attacks.
Equipment.Flavor Text: A favorite of veteran mercenaries, equally effective behind a shield or wielded with both hands.

Equipment.Name: Duelist's Rapier
Equipment.Ability 1: Precise Strike — once per turn, when attacking the only Enemy in your Location, gain +1 Attack.
Equipment.Ability 2: Riposte Master — once per Round after a melee Enemy Attack against you resolves, you may spend 1 Action to make a Basic Attack against that Enemy if it is a legal target.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Every thrust is measured. Every mistake is punished.

Equipment.Name: Greatsword of the Vanguard
Equipment.Ability 1: Cleave — after defeating an Enemy in your Location, make one additional attack against another Enemy there.
Equipment.Ability 2: Heavy Swing — cannot benefit from effects granting free Move Actions immediately before or after attacking.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Built to break battle lines with a single devastating sweep.

Equipment.Name: Blade of Ascendance
Equipment.Ability 1: Hero's Resolve — once per encounter, if reduced to 0 Health, remain at 1 instead.
Equipment.Ability 2: Ascendant Strike — once per encounter, when declaring an Attack with this weapon, that Attack ignores all Armor and Resistance.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Legends claim the first Hero wielded this blade to unite the realms against the darkness.

Equipment.Name: Woodcutter's Axe
Equipment.Ability 1: Chopping Blow — when attacking an enemy adjacent to terrain/structure, deal +1 Damage.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Built for timber, but just as capable of felling goblins.

Equipment.Name: Iron Hand Axe
Equipment.Ability 1: Cleaving Edge — if you defeat an enemy, next attack this turn gains +1 Attack.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Small enough to throw, deadly enough to keep.

Equipment.Name: Steel Battle Axe
Equipment.Ability 1: Sundering Blow — first time you damage an enemy each encounter, reduce its Armor by 1 for rest of encounter.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Every strike weakens armor until nothing remains but broken steel.

Equipment.Name: Berserker's Greataxe
Equipment.Ability 1: Reckless Assault — before attack, suffer 1 damage to deal +2 Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Heavy Weapon — cannot equip Shield.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Those who wield it know only one direction—forward.

Equipment.Name: Executioner's Axe
Equipment.Ability 1: Execution — against enemy at 25% Health or less, deal +3 Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Terrifying Presence — first enemy defeated each encounter causes adjacent enemies to become Shaken.
Equipment.Flavor Text: One swing ends the battle. The second is rarely needed.

Equipment.Name: Stormcleaver
Equipment.Ability 1: Chain Lightning — once each turn after dealing damage, deal 1 Lightning Damage to different enemy in target's Location.
Equipment.Ability 2: Thunder Crash — once per encounter after defeating enemy, nearby enemies become Staggered.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Every strike echoes like thunder across the battlefield.

Equipment.Name: Bloodletter Axe
Equipment.Ability 1: Deep Wounds — whenever you deal damage, target gains 1 Bleed Token.
Equipment.Ability 2: Blood Frenzy — when attacking Bleeding enemy, gain +1 Attack.
Equipment.Flavor Text: The crimson stains upon its blade never seem to dry.

Equipment.Name: Worldsplitter
Equipment.Ability 1: Earthshatter — once per encounter, all enemies in your Location suffer 4 Physical Damage and become Knocked Down.
Equipment.Ability 2: Titan's Strength — ignore Heavy penalty on two-handed weapons.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Forged by the giants before the first kingdoms rose.

Equipment.Name: Iron Mace
Equipment.Ability 1: Crushing Blow — ignore 1 Armor when attacking armored enemies.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Simple, brutal, and effective against steel-clad foes.

Equipment.Name: Steel Warhammer
Equipment.Ability 1: Concussive Strike — first enemy damaged each encounter becomes Staggered.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Every swing rattles bones and dents armor alike.

Equipment.Name: Maul of the Mountain
Equipment.Ability 1: Earthbreaker — after damaging enemy, may Push it 1 Location if legal.
Equipment.Ability 2: Heavy Impact — if enemy cannot be pushed, it instead suffers +1 Damage.
Equipment.Flavor Text: A weapon that strikes with the weight of a collapsing cliff.

Equipment.Name: Blessed Morningstar
Equipment.Ability 1: Holy Strike — Undead and Demons suffer +2 Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Divine Resolve — once per encounter after defeating Undead/Demon, recover 2 Health.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Consecrated in sacred rites, its radiant spikes banish darkness with every blow.

Equipment.Name: Skullcrusher
Equipment.Ability 1: Stunning Blow — once each turn after damage, target makes Stagger Save; failure becomes Stunned until end of next activation.
Equipment.Ability 2: Heavy Swing — cannot benefit from effects granting free Move Actions before attacking.
Equipment.Flavor Text: One clean strike is enough to end both the fight and the memory of it.

Equipment.Name: Hammer of Justice
Equipment.Ability 1: Judgment — against Armor 3+, ignore all Armor.
Equipment.Ability 2: Protector's Oath — allied Heroes in your Location gain +1 armor while you are not Exhausted.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Its ringing impact reminds the wicked that justice always arrives.

Equipment.Name: Titan's Maul
Equipment.Ability 1: Earthquake — once per encounter, all enemies in your Location and connected Locations suffer 3 Physical Damage and are Knocked Down.
Equipment.Ability 2: Unstoppable — cannot be Pushed, Pulled, or Knocked Down while wielding.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Forged for the champions of the ancient giants, every strike shakes the battlefield.

Equipment.Name: Relic of the First Forge
Equipment.Ability 1: Forgefire — attacks deal +1 Fire Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Master's Craft — at the start of an encounter choose +1 Attack, +1 armor, or Swift Craft. Swift Craft: once during each of your turns this encounter, perform 1 Move Action without spending an Action.
Equipment.Flavor Text: The first master smith forged this hammer to shape kingdoms rather than destroy them.

Equipment.Name: Iron Spear
Equipment.Ability 1: Long Reach — may attack enemies at your Location or a connected Location.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Simple in design, deadly in disciplined hands.

Equipment.Name: Steel Spear
Equipment.Ability 1: Brace — if an enemy moves into your Location from a connected Location, may immediately make a melee attack against it.
Equipment.Flavor Text: The first line rarely survives without disciplined spear walls.

Equipment.Name: Pike of the Watch
Equipment.Ability 1: Phalanx — while with another Hero wielding Spear/Polearm, both gain +1 armor.
Equipment.Ability 2: Brace — enemies moving into your reach provoke an Opportunity Attack.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Standing alone is bravery. Standing together is victory.

Equipment.Name: Halberd of the Vanguard
Equipment.Ability 1: Sweeping Strike — once each turn after damaging enemy, deal 1 damage to another enemy in target's Location.
Equipment.Ability 2: Hook — instead of damage, Pull target to your Location from connected Location if legal.
Equipment.Flavor Text: An elegant fusion of axe, spear, and hook.

Equipment.Name: Dragon Lance
Equipment.Ability 1: Charge — if move 2+ Locations before attacking, deal +2 Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Skewer — once per turn, if this attack defeats an Enemy, you may immediately perform 1 Move Action without spending an Action, if legally able to Move.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Forged for dragon hunters, every charge strikes with unstoppable force.

Equipment.Name: Trident of the Tides
Equipment.Ability 1: Tidal Pull — once each turn after damaging enemy, Push or Pull it 1 Location if legal.
Equipment.Ability 2: Flowing armor — if no enemies in your Location at end of turn, gain +1 armor until next turn.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Blessed by the sea gods, it commands the ebb and flow of every battle.

Equipment.Name: Glaive of the Eclipse
Equipment.Ability 1: Sweeping Arc — when attacking, may also deal 2 Damage to one other enemy in target's Location.
Equipment.Ability 2: Zone of Control — an Enemy leaving your Location must spend 1 additional Movement.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Its blade casts a shadow long before its wielder arrives.

Equipment.Name: Spear of the First King
Equipment.Ability 1: Rally — allied Heroes in your Location gain +1 Attack while you are not Exhausted.
Equipment.Ability 2: King's Command — once per encounter after your turn, one allied Hero in your Location may Move to connected Location and make one basic attack.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Raised high during the founding of the first kingdom, this spear inspired ordinary soldiers to become legends.

Equipment.Name: Iron Dagger
Equipment.Ability 1: Quick Draw — during first round, first attack gains +2 attack.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Small enough to conceal, sharp enough to matter.

Equipment.Name: Steel Dagger
Equipment.Ability 1: Backstab — if target shares Location with one of your allies, deal +2 Damage.
Equipment.Flavor Text: A silent blade that strikes where armor offers no protection.

Equipment.Name: Assassin's Dirk
Equipment.Ability 1: Critical Precision — the first Attack you make each turn against an Enemy that has a Status gains +1 Attack.
Equipment.Ability 2: Silent Killer — if you defeat an enemy, immediately move up to 2 connected Locations as allowed.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Its victims rarely realize they've been struck until it's too late.

Equipment.Name: Venomfang
Equipment.Ability 1: Envenomed Blade — when you deal damage, target gains 1 Poison Token.
Equipment.Ability 2: Toxic Wounds — Poisoned enemies suffer -1 armor.
Equipment.Flavor Text: A single cut begins a slow and agonizing end.

Equipment.Name: Twinfang Blades
Equipment.Ability 1: Twin Strike — once each turn after successful attack, make second attack against same target; second deals -1 Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Flurry — if both attacks hit, you may immediately perform 1 Move Action without spending an Action, if legally able to Move.
Equipment.Flavor Text: One blade distracts. The second finishes the job.

Equipment.Name: Shadowfang
Equipment.Ability 1: Fade Away — after dealing damage, move up to 2 connected Locations as allowed without reactions.
Equipment.Ability 2: Strike from Darkness — if target has not activated this round, deal +2 Damage.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Its edge disappears into darkness moments before it finds its mark.

Equipment.Name: King's Mercy
Equipment.Ability 1: Royal Execution — against enemies below 50% Health, attacks ignore all Armor.
Equipment.Ability 2: Precise Finish — if this weapon defeats enemy, refresh one Hero Ability on cooldown.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Carried by royal executioners, its purpose was swift justice without needless suffering.

Equipment.Name: Night's Whisper
Equipment.Ability 1: Invisible Death — first attack each encounter automatically gains Advantage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Death's Dance — once per encounter after defeating enemy, immediately take another full turn.
Equipment.Flavor Text: No one remembers seeing the blade. They only remember the silence that followed.

Equipment.Name: Hunting Bow
Equipment.Ability 1: Hunter's Eye — attacks against Beasts gain +1 Damage.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Simple enough for the village hunter, deadly enough for the battlefield.

Equipment.Name: Longbow
Equipment.Ability 1: Deadly Aim — if you did not Move this turn, gain +1 Attack.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Patience turns every arrow into a certainty.

Equipment.Name: Elven Longbow
Equipment.Ability 1: Graceful Shot — after attacking, move to a connected Location if legal.
Equipment.Ability 2: Eagle Eye — ignore Cover when making ranged attacks.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Its arrows fly as silently as the forests from which it came.

Equipment.Name: Recurve Bow
Equipment.Ability 1: Rapid Shot — once each turn, make second ranged attack against a different target; second deals -1 Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Mobile Archer — may move before attacking normally.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Favored by mounted scouts and skirmishers, it delivers arrows with astonishing speed.

Equipment.Name: Storm Bow
Equipment.Ability 1: Chain Shot — once each turn after damage, deal 1 Lightning Damage to another enemy in target's Location.
Equipment.Ability 2: Static Charge — if same enemy is hit on consecutive turns, it becomes Staggered.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Each arrow carries the fury of a gathering storm.

Equipment.Name: Phoenix Bow
Equipment.Ability 1: Flaming Arrow — attacks deal +1 Fire Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Rebirth — once per encounter if reduced to 0 Health, remain at 1.
Equipment.Flavor Text: The flames upon its string never consume the bow—only its enemies.

Equipment.Name: Starfall Longbow
Equipment.Ability 1: Falling Star — once per encounter, choose a Location within range; every enemy there suffers 4 Radiant Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Celestial Aim — ignore all Cover and Line-of-Sight penalties.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Forged from a fragment of a fallen star, its arrows never lose their way.

Equipment.Name: Bow of the World Tree
Equipment.Ability 1: Living Arrow — start of turn choose Vine (Root target), Bloom (ally in target Location recovers 2 Health), or Thorn (+2 Damage).
Equipment.Ability 2: Ancient Wisdom — +1 Range and +1 attack.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Carved from the first branch of the World Tree, every arrow carries the will of the living forest.

Equipment.Name: Light Crossbow
Equipment.Ability 1: Armor Piercer — ignore 1 Armor.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Easy to master, difficult to survive.

Equipment.Name: Heavy Crossbow
Equipment.Ability 1: Powerful Shot — ignore 2 Armor.
Equipment.Ability 2: Reload — after attacking, cannot use again until spending 1 Action to reload.
Equipment.Flavor Text: One bolt can punch through a knight's breastplate—but only if you have time to reload.

Equipment.Name: Repeating Crossbow
Equipment.Ability 1: Rapid Fire — make two attacks against same or different targets; each deals -1 Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Magazine — may use Rapid Fire for three attacks before reloading; reload costs 1 Action.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Innovation transformed a cumbersome siege weapon into a storm of steel.

Equipment.Name: Sniper Crossbow
Equipment.Ability 1: Deadeye — if you did not Move this turn, gain +2 attack.
Equipment.Ability 2: Heartseeker — once per turn, if you did not Move this turn, an Attack with this weapon ignores 2 Armor.
Equipment.Flavor Text: One bolt. One target. One outcome.

Equipment.Name: Explosive Crossbow
Equipment.Ability 1: Explosive Bolt — target one enemy; normal damage; all other enemies in that Location suffer 2 Fire Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Reload — after Explosive Bolt, reload before firing again.
Equipment.Flavor Text: A single bolt can scatter an entire warband.

Equipment.Name: Arcane Ballista
Equipment.Ability 1: Arcane Bolt — ignore all Armor and Magical Barriers.
Equipment.Ability 2: Arcane Recharge — after attacking becomes Exhausted; readies automatically at start of next turn.
Equipment.Flavor Text: More siege engine than crossbow, its enchanted limbs hurl bolts capable of piercing castle walls.

Equipment.Name: Dragonkiller Crossbow
Equipment.Ability 1: Slayer Bolt — against Boss or Elite enemies, deal +3 Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Crippling Shot — once per encounter, after an Attack with this weapon deals Damage, the target's Movement becomes 0 until the end of its next activation.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Forged after the Dragon Wars, every mechanism exists for one purpose—to bring giants and monsters to their knees.

Equipment.Name: Heaven's Judgment
Equipment.Ability 1: Divine Bolt — attacks ignore all Cover and Armor.
Equipment.Ability 2: Judgment — once per encounter, when declaring an Attack with this weapon, declare Judgment. After that Attack deals Damage, the target cannot use Reactions until the end of its next activation and suffers +3 Radiant Damage.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Its bolts shine like falling stars, delivering judgment with unerring precision.

Equipment.Name: Apprentice's Staff
Equipment.Ability 1: Arcane Focus — the first Arcane Hero Deck card you play each encounter costs 1 fewer Action (minimum 0).
Equipment.Flavor Text: Every archmage once carried a staff no more impressive than this.

Equipment.Name: Staff of Embers
Equipment.Ability 1: Firebolt — basic attacks deal +1 Fire Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Kindling Flame — enemies damaged by Fire abilities gain 1 Burn Token.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Its crystal glows like a coal that never cools.

Equipment.Name: Staff of Frost
Equipment.Ability 1: Frostbolt — basic attacks reduce target Movement by 1 until end of next activation.
Equipment.Ability 2: Ice Prison — once per encounter when damaging with Cold ability, Root target until end of next activation.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Winter follows wherever its bearer walks.

Equipment.Name: Stormcaller's Staff
Equipment.Ability 1: Chain Lightning — first time each turn you deal Lightning damage, another enemy in target's Location suffers 1 Lightning Damage.
Equipment.Ability 2: Charged Focus — after Lightning ability, gain +1 attack on next attack/spell this round.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Thunder answers the call of those worthy enough to wield it.

Equipment.Name: Staff of Renewal
Equipment.Ability 1: Healing Surge — whenever you restore Health to an ally, they recover +2 additional Health.
Equipment.Ability 2: Blessed Aura — allied Heroes in your Location gain +1 Magic Resistance.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Life flourishes wherever its crystal touches the earth.

Equipment.Name: Staff of the Ancient Grove
Equipment.Ability 1: Grasping Vines — once each turn when damaging with Nature ability, may Root target.
Equipment.Ability 2: Nature's Blessing — start of turn recover 1 Health if in natural terrain.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Carved from the heartwood of an ancient tree that has witnessed the rise and fall of kingdoms.

Equipment.Name: Archmage's Staff
Equipment.Ability 1: Arcane Mastery — the first Arcane Hero Deck card you play each round costs 1 fewer Action (minimum 0).
Equipment.Ability 2: Spell Echo — once per encounter, after you resolve an Arcane Hero Deck card, you may play a different Arcane Hero Deck card from your hand with printed Action Cost 1 or less without spending an Action.
Equipment.Flavor Text: The greatest mages never worried about running out of power—only how best to wield it.

Equipment.Name: Worldheart Staff
Equipment.Ability 1: Harmony of Creation — start encounter choose Flame (+2 Fire Damage), Frost (Cold Slows), Storm (Lightning chains), or Life (+2 Healing).
Equipment.Ability 2: Worldheart's Gift — once per encounter refresh one Ability on cooldown.
Equipment.Flavor Text: It is said this staff contains a fragment of the world's first spark of magic.

Equipment.Name: Apprentice's Wand
Equipment.Ability 1: Quick Cast — first spell each round gains +1 attack.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Small enough for a novice, precise enough for a master.

Equipment.Name: Wand of Sparks
Equipment.Ability 1: Arc Lightning — whenever you deal Lightning damage, one other enemy in target's Location suffers 1 Lightning Damage.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Tiny arcs dance across its polished surface, eager for their next target.

Equipment.Name: Wand of Illusions
Equipment.Ability 1: Mirror Image — once per encounter when targeted, force attacker to reroll attack.
Equipment.Ability 2: Distracting Glamour — enemies damaged by Arcane abilities suffer -1 attack until end of next activation.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Reality bends around its bearer, leaving enemies unsure of what is real.

Equipment.Name: Wand of Shadows
Equipment.Ability 1: Shadow Step — after casting a spell, move to a connected Location without reactions.
Equipment.Ability 2: Dark Hex — first enemy damaged each round suffers -1 armor until start of your next turn.
Equipment.Flavor Text: It leaves no light behind—only silence.

Equipment.Name: Wand of Curses
Equipment.Ability 1: Hex — first enemy damaged each round suffers one chosen effect until end of next activation: -2 Attack, -2 armor, or -2 Movement.
Equipment.Ability 2: Lingering Curse — Bosses and Elites cannot ignore your debuffs.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Every whispered incantation steals a little hope from its victim.

Equipment.Name: Wand of Time
Equipment.Ability 1: Temporal Shift — once per encounter after any Hero finishes turn, choose: they immediately Move up to one connected Location, or make one basic Attack.
Equipment.Ability 2: Accelerate — the first Arcane Hero Deck card you play each encounter costs 0 Actions.
Equipment.Flavor Text: To its wielder, time is merely another spell waiting to be cast.

Equipment.Name: Wand of the Phoenix
Equipment.Ability 1: Phoenix Flame — whenever Fire abilities deal damage, recover 1 Health.
Equipment.Ability 2: Rebirth — once per campaign if defeated, discard this Equipment; recover to 50% Health, remove all negative Conditions, stand if Knocked Down.
Equipment.Flavor Text: The phoenix dies only to rise stronger. Those worthy enough to wield this wand may do the same.

Equipment.Name: Scepter of Ascendance
Equipment.Ability 1: Master of Magic — start encounter choose two Magic Schools; abilities from them gain +2 Damage or +2 Healing.
Equipment.Ability 2: Arcane Conduit — once per round, after you resolve an Arcane Hero Deck card, you may play a different Arcane Hero Deck card from your hand with printed Action Cost 1 or less without spending an Action. Ascendant Will — immune to Silenced and Disarmed.
Equipment.Flavor Text: The greatest relic ever forged, the Scepter of Ascendance is said to contain the first spark of creation itself.

Equipment.Name: Wooden Buckler
Equipment.Ability 1: Quick Block — once per round reduce damage from one attack by 1.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Crude, lightweight, and surprisingly dependable.

Equipment.Name: Iron Shield
Equipment.Ability 1: Shield Wall — allied Heroes in your Location gain +1 armor against ranged attacks.
Equipment.Flavor Text: A soldier's first line of defense.

Equipment.Name: Tower Shield
Equipment.Ability 1: Fortress — cannot be Pushed or Knocked Down.
Equipment.Ability 2: Cover — allied Heroes in your Location gain Cover against ranged attacks. Bulky — your first Move Action each turn costs 1 additional Action.
Equipment.Flavor Text: An advancing wall of iron.

Equipment.Name: Spiked Shield
Equipment.Ability 1: Shield Bash — once each turn after blocking attack, deal 1 Physical Damage to attacker.
Equipment.Ability 2: Brutal Counter — if attacker is in your Location, may Push it to a connected Location if legal.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Sometimes the best defense is striking back.

Equipment.Name: Padded Gambeson
Equipment.Ability 1: Layered Padding — reduce the first Physical damage you suffer each round by 1.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Quilted linen and wool turn aside cuts better than bare skin.
Equipment.Design Notes: Entry-level armor built for the auto-hit system.

Equipment.Name: Leather Jerkin
Equipment.Ability 1: Flexible Fit — this Armor never increases the Action cost of your Move Actions.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Supple hide protects without slowing the wearer.

Equipment.Name: Studded Leather
Equipment.Ability 1: Reinforced — once per round when damage would be exactly 1, reduce it to 0.
Equipment.Flavor Text: Iron studs reinforce every vulnerable seam.

Equipment.Name: Shadowleather Coat
