Loot Deck.Name: Bandage Roll
Loot Deck.Effect: Remove Bleeding from a Hero at your Location; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Clean cloth is sometimes more valuable than steel.

Loot Deck.Name: Antidote
Loot Deck.Effect: Remove Poisoned from a Hero at your Location; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Bitter enough to make the poison seem pleasant by comparison.

Loot Deck.Name: Burn Salve
Loot Deck.Effect: Remove Burning from a Hero at your Location; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A cooling paste packed in a wax-sealed clay jar.

Loot Deck.Name: Restorative Tonic
Loot Deck.Effect: Remove Weakened from a Hero and recover 1 Health; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The tonic tastes terrible, which the brewer insists proves it works.

Loot Deck.Name: Smelling Salts
Loot Deck.Effect: Remove Stunned from a Hero at your Location; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: One sharp breath is enough to drag the senses back into focus.

Loot Deck.Name: Focus Tonic
Loot Deck.Effect: Gain Inspired until the end of your next turn; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: For a few moments every sound sharpens and every movement becomes deliberate.

Loot Deck.Name: Guarding Draught
Loot Deck.Effect: Gain Guard; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A metallic tonic favored by caravan guards before a dangerous crossing.

Loot Deck.Name: Stamina Draught
Loot Deck.Effect: Gain 1 Action this turn; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The rush is brief, but sometimes one more action is all that matters.

Loot Deck.Name: Traveler's Rations
Loot Deck.Effect: When you Rest, recover 1 additional Health; discard after resolving the Rest.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Dried meat, hard bread, and enough salt to survive a week.

Loot Deck.Name: Herbal Poultice
Loot Deck.Effect: Recover 1 Health and remove Bleeding; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Crushed leaves wrapped beneath linen stop the bleeding surprisingly well.

Loot Deck.Name: Purifying Herbs
Loot Deck.Effect: Choose Poisoned or Burning; remove that Condition from a Hero at your Location; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The sharp-smelling bundle is prized by hunters and healers alike.

Loot Deck.Name: Smoke Bomb
Loot Deck.Effect: Choose your Location. Until the end of the turn, Heroes there may voluntarily Move while Engaged; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Gray smoke floods the area before anyone can react.

Loot Deck.Name: Fire Flask
Loot Deck.Effect: Choose an enemy at your Location or a connected Location. It suffers 2 damage and gains Burning; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Oil and resin turn a simple bottle into a frightening weapon.

Loot Deck.Name: Frost Flask
Loot Deck.Effect: Choose an enemy at your Location or a connected Location. It gains Slowed until the end of its next activation; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Ice forms across the glass even beside a warm fire.

Loot Deck.Name: Thunderstone
Loot Deck.Effect: Choose an enemy at your Location. It gains Stunned; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The stone cracks like thunder when it strikes the ground.

Loot Deck.Name: Throwing Knife
Loot Deck.Effect: Choose an enemy at your Location or a connected Location. It suffers 2 damage; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Balanced for one purpose and rarely recovered afterward.

Loot Deck.Name: Heavy Throwing Axe
Loot Deck.Effect: Choose an enemy at your Location. It suffers 3 damage; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Too heavy for subtlety, but subtlety is not always required.

Loot Deck.Name: Caltrops
Loot Deck.Effect: Place a Caltrops token at your Location. The next enemy that enters suffers 1 damage and ends its movement; then remove the token.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A handful of sharpened iron can control an entire passage.

Loot Deck.Name: Hunting Trap
Loot Deck.Effect: Place a Trap token at your Location. The next enemy that enters gains Rooted until the end of its activation; then remove the token.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A steel jaw hidden beneath leaves rewards careless pursuit.

Loot Deck.Name: Torch
Loot Deck.Effect: Ignore one Dark or visibility restriction affecting you until the end of the round; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A little light goes a long way underground.

Loot Deck.Name: Lantern Oil
Loot Deck.Effect: Choose: extend a Torch effect through the end of your next turn, or remove Burning from a Location/object if the effect can reasonably be extinguished; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Useful for light, fire, and occasionally putting one out.

Loot Deck.Name: Rope & Grapnel
Loot Deck.Effect: Move to one connected revealed Location. Ignore Difficult Terrain, climbing, rubble, and similar terrain-based movement restrictions during this movement. Discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A length of good rope solves more problems than most weapons.

Loot Deck.Name: Lockpick Set
Loot Deck.Effect: Bypass one Locked or simple Trap restriction at your Location without paying its additional Action cost. Then immediately perform the associated Interact or Search without spending an additional Action. Discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Thin steel picks wrapped in soft leather for quiet work.

Loot Deck.Name: Scout's Kit
Loot Deck.Effect: When you Explore, draw 2 valid Exploration cards. Choose 1 to resolve and discard the other; discard this card after use.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Charcoal, cord, markers, and a small lens help turn searching into method.

Loot Deck.Name: Whetstone
Loot Deck.Effect: Choose your equipped Weapon. It gains +1 Weapon for your next Attack this turn; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A few practiced strokes can make an old edge dangerous again.

Loot Deck.Name: Emergency Supplies
Loot Deck.Effect: Recover 2 Health and draw 1 Hero card; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A compact bundle assembled for exactly the moment everything goes wrong.

Loot Deck.Name: Phoenix Ash
Loot Deck.Effect: Remove all negative Conditions from one Hero and recover 3 Health; discard.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The warm ash glows briefly when scattered over the wounded.

Loot Deck.Name: Iron Ore
Loot Deck.Effect: Raw metal used by Blacksmithing. Combine with Coal or Refined Iron in basic metal recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Heavy red-brown ore streaked with metallic gray.

Loot Deck.Name: Copper Ore
Loot Deck.Effect: Raw metal used for fittings, traps, tools, and low-tier weapon components.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Soft reddish ore that works easily beneath a hammer.

Loot Deck.Name: Tin Ore
Loot Deck.Used By: Blacksmithing — bronze fittings and utility gear
Loot Deck.Effect: Combine with Copper Ore in bronze recipes or use for light metal fittings.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Pale ore valued less for strength than for what it becomes when alloyed.

Loot Deck.Name: Coal
Loot Deck.Effect: Fuel for Forge recipes and an ingredient in fire-based alchemy.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Black stone that burns hotter than ordinary wood.

Loot Deck.Name: Silver Ore
Loot Deck.Used By: Blacksmithing; Enchanting — silvered weapons, holy gear
Loot Deck.Effect: Refine for silvered weapon and sacred crafting recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Bright veins glimmer even beneath cave dust.

Loot Deck.Name: Gold Ore
Loot Deck.Effect: Refine for jewelry, enchantment settings, and valuable ceremonial items.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Dense yellow ore prized by merchants and enchanters alike.

Loot Deck.Name: Mythril Ore
Loot Deck.Used By: Legendary Blacksmithing — light armor, elite weapons
Loot Deck.Effect: Rare metal used in high-tier weapons and armor; counts as a Rare Metal component.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Silvery-blue ore that feels far lighter than it should.

Loot Deck.Name: Refined Iron
Loot Deck.Effect: Processed iron ready for use in forged Equipment recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A clean bar of iron waiting for a smith's hammer.

Loot Deck.Name: Steel Ingot
Loot Deck.Used By: Blacksmithing — reinforced weapons and heavy armor
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in reinforced weapons, heavy armor, shields, and durable tools.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Dark steel rings sharply when struck.

Loot Deck.Name: Obsidian Chunk
Loot Deck.Effect: Used for edged weapons, fire-resistant fittings, and arcane components.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Volcanic glass with an edge sharper than common steel.

Loot Deck.Name: Oak Timber
Loot Deck.Effect: Sturdy wood used for weapon hafts, shields, and structural crafting.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Straight-grained oak cut from mature frontier trees.

Loot Deck.Name: Pine Lumber
Loot Deck.Used By: Woodworking; Campcraft — basic structures and supplies
Loot Deck.Effect: Common construction wood used in campcraft, traps, and utility recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Light, resinous boards that are easy to shape.

Loot Deck.Name: Hardwood Plank
Loot Deck.Effect: Dense hardwood used for stronger bows, shields, and reinforced equipment.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The plank resists both bending and splitting.

Loot Deck.Name: Yew Branch
Loot Deck.Effect: Flexible wood prized for high-quality ranged weapon recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A naturally curved branch perfect for a bowyer's hands.

Loot Deck.Name: Ancient Bark
Loot Deck.Effect: Rare nature component used in protective wards and restorative recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The bark smells faintly of rain even when completely dry.

Loot Deck.Name: Ironwood Log
Loot Deck.Used By: Woodworking; Blacksmithing — reinforced hafts and shields
Loot Deck.Effect: Counts as both Wood and Reinforcement for appropriate crafting recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Wood so dense that axes spark when they strike it.

Loot Deck.Name: Flexible Reed
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in arrows, snares, light tools, and campcraft recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Simple reeds become surprisingly useful in skilled hands.

Loot Deck.Name: Resin Clump
Loot Deck.Effect: Sticky resin used for adhesives, fire mixtures, and waterproofing.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Amber resin clings stubbornly to anything it touches.

Loot Deck.Name: Leather Hide
Loot Deck.Effect: Basic hide used in leather armor, straps, packs, and utility gear.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A cleaned hide ready for tanning.

Loot Deck.Name: Thick Hide
Loot Deck.Effect: Heavy hide used in durable armor and reinforced equipment.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Scarred hide thick enough to turn a glancing blade.

Loot Deck.Name: Fine Leather
Loot Deck.Effect: High-quality leather used in advanced armor and accessories.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Supple, carefully tanned leather without a visible flaw.

Loot Deck.Name: Linen Cloth
Loot Deck.Used By: Tailoring; Alchemy — bandages, clothing, potion wraps
Loot Deck.Effect: Common cloth used in tailoring, bandages, and utility crafting.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Plain woven linen—simple, clean, and endlessly useful.

Loot Deck.Name: Wool Cloth
Loot Deck.Effect: Warm cloth used for cloaks, padding, and camp supplies.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Coarse wool made for cold nights rather than noble halls.

Loot Deck.Name: Spider Silk
Loot Deck.Effect: Exceptionally strong fiber used in advanced cloth and lightweight armor.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Silken strands stronger than cord and lighter than linen.

Loot Deck.Name: Moonleaf
Loot Deck.Effect: Restorative herb used in healing and recovery recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Silver-edged leaves curl toward moonlight after dusk.

Loot Deck.Name: Kingsroot
Loot Deck.Effect: Medicinal root used to cleanse toxins and strengthen restorative mixtures.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A bitter golden root treasured by frontier healers.

Loot Deck.Name: Glow Moss
Loot Deck.Used By: Alchemy; Enchanting — light and vision effects
Loot Deck.Effect: Luminescent moss used in light-producing and visibility recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Blue-green moss that glows long after being scraped from stone.

Loot Deck.Name: Bloodflower
Loot Deck.Effect: Potent alchemical flower used in offensive and restorative mixtures.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Its dark petals stain the fingers crimson.

Loot Deck.Name: Sun Blossom
Loot Deck.Effect: Bright herb used in purification and protective elixirs.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The flower remains warm even after sunset.

Loot Deck.Name: Nightshade
Loot Deck.Effect: Toxic herb used in poison, weakening, and stealth mixtures.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Beautiful purple berries conceal a dangerous bitterness.

Loot Deck.Name: Crystal Shard
Loot Deck.Effect: Arcane crystal used to hold simple enchantments and magical charges.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Light fractures into tiny rainbows along its sharp edges.

Loot Deck.Name: Mana Crystal
Loot Deck.Effect: A concentrated arcane component used in high-tier enchantments.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The crystal vibrates faintly when magic is nearby.

Loot Deck.Name: Runestone Fragment
Loot Deck.Effect: Piece of an inscribed stone used for runic enchantments and ancient mechanisms.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Only half a rune remains, yet it still hums with power.

Loot Deck.Name: Enchanted Dust
Loot Deck.Used By: Enchanting — magical upgrades and relic work
Loot Deck.Effect: Fine magical residue used to bind enchantments to equipment.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The dust refuses to settle on ordinary surfaces.

Loot Deck.Name: Arcane Resin
Loot Deck.Used By: Enchanting; Alchemy — magical coatings and bombs
Loot Deck.Effect: Sticky magical binder used in enchanted weapon coatings and alchemical devices.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The translucent resin glows when spread thin.

Loot Deck.Name: Void Crystal
Loot Deck.Used By: Legendary Enchanting — shadow and control effects
Loot Deck.Effect: Extremely rare component used only in Epic or Legendary enchantments.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A black crystal that seems to swallow nearby light.

Loot Deck.Name: Aether Bloom
Loot Deck.Used By: Alchemy; Enchanting — movement and free-action effects
Loot Deck.Effect: Rare flower used in mobility, ethereal, and action-enhancing recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Its translucent petals drift as if untouched by gravity.

Loot Deck.Name: Spirit Essence
Loot Deck.Effect: Spiritual reagent used in holy, warding, and relic recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A pale light swirls inside the sealed vial.

Loot Deck.Name: Runic Ink
Loot Deck.Used By: Enchanting; Scrollcraft — runes and magical inscriptions
Loot Deck.Effect: Special ink required for permanent runes, scrolls, and sigils.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The ink settles into symbols before the quill finishes moving.

Loot Deck.Name: Blessed Silver
Loot Deck.Used By: Sacred Blacksmithing; Enchanting — holy weapons and wards
Loot Deck.Effect: Consecrated metal used against corrupted, cursed, and unholy threats.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The polished silver remains warm in the presence of darkness.

Loot Deck.Name: Goblin Ear
Loot Deck.Effect: Proof of a Goblin kill. Used by bounty quests and a few crude alchemical recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A grisly but unmistakable token of a defeated goblin.

Loot Deck.Name: Goblin Tooth
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in low-tier trinkets, charms, and intimidation-themed recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Small, sharp, and usually in worse condition than the goblin it came from.

Loot Deck.Name: Goblin Banner Scrap
Loot Deck.Effect: Can be turned in as evidence of disrupting Goblin forces or used in trophy crafting.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Smoke-blackened cloth marked with a crude clan symbol.

Loot Deck.Name: Goblin Iron Token
Loot Deck.Effect: A stamped command token accepted by certain quest givers as proof of an Elite kill.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The crude iron disc bears the mark of a higher-ranking warband.

Loot Deck.Name: Raider War Paint
Loot Deck.Effect: Pigment used in intimidation mixtures and Goblin-themed quest objectives.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The greasy red paste smells of ash, fat, and bitter herbs.

Loot Deck.Name: Scout Tracking Map
Loot Deck.Effect: Discard during an Explore to look at the top 2 Exploration cards and put them back in any order.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A rough charcoal map showing patrol routes and hidden paths.

Loot Deck.Name: Archer Bowstring
Loot Deck.Effect: Crafting component for bows, traps, and ranged utility gear.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Crude but surprisingly strong cord twisted from sinew and fiber.

Loot Deck.Name: Captain Crest
Loot Deck.Effect: Counts as an Elite Goblin trophy for quests and special crafting recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A hammered iron badge worn only by Goblin commanders.

Loot Deck.Name: Wolf Pelt
Loot Deck.Effect: Hide used in cloaks, light armor, and cold-weather gear.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Soft gray fur still carries the scent of pine.

Loot Deck.Name: Wolf Fang
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in fang charms, knife decorations, and hunter recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A curved fang polished smooth at the tip.

Loot Deck.Name: Bear Claw
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in heavy hunting weapons, charms, and prestige recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The claw is nearly as long as a dagger blade.

Loot Deck.Name: Thick Beast Hide
Loot Deck.Effect: Counts as Thick Hide and a Beast trophy for crafting requirements.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Scarred hide toughened by a lifetime of fighting.

Loot Deck.Name: Spider Silk Gland
Loot Deck.Effect: Process to create Spider Silk or use directly in web-based traps.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The pale gland still extrudes sticky silk when squeezed.

Loot Deck.Name: Venom Sac
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in poison recipes or refined into antidote ingredients.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A translucent sac filled with dangerous yellow venom.

Loot Deck.Name: Beast Heart
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in powerful vigor brews, beast rituals, and hunter quests.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Still warm when harvested, pulsing with fading strength.

Loot Deck.Name: Warg Hide
Loot Deck.Effect: Rare hide used in durable armor and fear-themed accessories.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Coarse black fur overlays a hide thicker than ordinary wolf leather.

Loot Deck.Name: Warg Fang
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in aggressive weapon upgrades and hunter reward recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The serrated fang is stained dark near the root.

Loot Deck.Name: Cave Bear Paw
Loot Deck.Effect: Counts as a Large Beast trophy and rare component for heavy equipment.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The paw alone is larger than a goblin's head.

Loot Deck.Name: Owlbear Feather
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in precision fletching, cloaks, and beast-themed accessories.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A broad mottled feather with a surprisingly rigid spine.

Loot Deck.Name: Owlbear Talon
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in brutal melee weapon upgrades and elite hunter commissions.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Curved like a hook and hard enough to score steel.

Loot Deck.Name: Spider Matriarch Fang
Loot Deck.Effect: Rare venom component used in Epic poison and assassination recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The hollow fang still beads with venom.

Loot Deck.Name: Goblin Shaman Fetish
Loot Deck.Effect: Arcane trophy used in anti-Goblin wards, ritual recipes, and story objectives.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Bone, feathers, and runes bound together with black cord.

Loot Deck.Name: War Chief's Signet
Loot Deck.Effect: Unique command trophy. Quest effects may require it as proof the War Chief is defeated.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A crude bronze signet worn as if it were a king's seal.

Loot Deck.Name: Chieftain's Crown Fragment
Loot Deck.Effect: Unique Boss component used in Campaign rewards and Goblin Uprising legendary recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A jagged piece of iron and bone torn from the Chieftain's crown.

Loot Deck.Name: Corrupted Totem Core
Loot Deck.Effect: Rare corrupted component. May be purified by a Quest or consumed in high-tier Enchanting.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Dark energy throbs beneath the carved wooden shell.

Loot Deck.Name: Copper Ingot
Loot Deck.Effect: May be sold normally or used as a refined Copper component in crafting.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A neat stamped bar accepted by smiths throughout the frontier.

Loot Deck.Name: Silver Ingot
Loot Deck.Effect: High-value trade metal; also counts as refined Silver for recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A bright bar stamped with an old merchant's mark.

Loot Deck.Name: Gold Ingot
Loot Deck.Effect: High-value trade good and premium crafting component.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Dense, heavy, and universally understood.

Loot Deck.Name: Ancient Coin
Loot Deck.Effect: Sell for its listed Value or retain for collector and ancient-history interactions.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The worn face on the coin belongs to no ruler anyone remembers.

Loot Deck.Name: Dwarven Steel Bar
Loot Deck.Effect: Counts as Steel plus one additional Rare Metal component in Masterwork recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Perfectly forged metal bearing a maker's rune along one edge.

Loot Deck.Name: Rough Emerald
Loot Deck.Effect: Gem used in nature, healing, and precision enchantments.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Cloudy green stone waiting for a careful cut.

Loot Deck.Name: Polished Sapphire
Loot Deck.Effect: Gem used in control, protection, and arcane equipment recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Deep blue facets catch even the faintest light.

Loot Deck.Name: Ruby Gemstone
Loot Deck.Effect: Gem used in offensive and fire-themed enchantments.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A blood-red stone that feels faintly warm.

Loot Deck.Name: Black Pearl
Loot Deck.Effect: Rare luxury component used in shadow and concealment recipes.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Its surface reflects no face clearly.

Loot Deck.Name: Moonstone
Loot Deck.Effect: Gem used in sacred, vision, and exploration-focused enchantments.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Pale light seems trapped beneath its milky surface.

Loot Deck.Name: Fine Silk
Loot Deck.Effect: Luxury cloth used in advanced garments and high-value trade.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Smooth fabric dyed in colors Stonebrook cannot produce.

Loot Deck.Name: Exotic Spices
Loot Deck.Effect: Used in Campcraft recipes or sold as valuable caravan cargo.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The scent fills a room before the pouch is opened.

Loot Deck.Name: Rare Wine
Loot Deck.Effect: Luxury trade item valued by nobles, merchants, and certain NPCs.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A sealed bottle from a vineyard far beyond the frontier.

Loot Deck.Name: Ivory Carving
Loot Deck.Effect: Sell for its listed Value or use in collector and noble interactions.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A tiny mounted knight carved with astonishing precision.

Loot Deck.Name: Artisan Tools
Loot Deck.Effect: A Hero using these for a crafting interaction may satisfy a basic Tool requirement when the Scenario allows.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A fitted case of files, hammers, awls, and fine measuring tools.

Loot Deck.Name: Dragon Incense
Loot Deck.Effect: Consumed by certain ritual recipes or dragon-related story interactions.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Dense smoke curls into shapes that resemble wings.

Loot Deck.Name: Ancient Map Fragment
Loot Deck.Effect: Keep. Some Quests or Exploration effects require multiple Map Fragments to reveal hidden content.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A torn piece of vellum showing roads no longer found on modern maps.

Loot Deck.Name: Royal Seal
Loot Deck.Effect: Unique proof of authority used in high-level story and faction interactions; cannot be sold unless a rule allows it.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Heavy gold stamped with a crowned lion.

Loot Deck.Name: Merchant Ledger
Loot Deck.Effect: Can be turned in during merchant or caravan objectives; otherwise sell for listed Value.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Names, routes, and debts fill every narrow line.

Loot Deck.Name: Sealed Trade Contract
Loot Deck.Effect: Keep until used by a Quest or merchant interaction; may unlock a special trade option.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Wax seals bind an agreement worth far more than the paper itself.

Loot Deck.Name: Stonebrook Gate Key
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Unlocks a specified Stonebrook gate, storehouse, or locked objective when instructed by a Quest.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A heavy iron key stamped with Stonebrook's crest.

Loot Deck.Name: Goblin Lookout Key
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Opens a locked Goblin Lookout cache or objective when instructed.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Crude iron key tied to a strip of red cloth.

Loot Deck.Name: Watchtower Vault Key
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Opens the Watchtower's sealed armory or vault when instructed.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The old key bears the same tower emblem carved into the Beacon base.

Loot Deck.Name: Merchant Strongbox Key
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Opens the Merchant Caravan's strongbox when the relevant Quest allows it.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A brass key worn smooth from years on a merchant's chain.

Loot Deck.Name: Ancient Rune Seal
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. May be consumed or presented to bypass one matching Ancient Seal when instructed by a Quest.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The palm-sized stone carries a complete glowing rune.

Loot Deck.Name: Scout's Journal
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. When a Quest references Goblin patrol intelligence, this satisfies that requirement.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Short notes list routes, signals, and the names of missing patrols.

Loot Deck.Name: Captain's Orders
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Reveals the next Goblin objective or satisfies a Campaign intelligence requirement.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The parchment carries commands from someone higher than the Captain.

Loot Deck.Name: Caravan Manifest
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Used to verify recovered caravan cargo or complete delivery objectives.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Every crate, barrel, and passenger is recorded in careful ink.

Loot Deck.Name: Royal Proclamation
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Unlocks royal or official story interactions when referenced by the Campaign.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The proclamation names the Heroes as agents of the realm.

Loot Deck.Name: Explorer's Field Notes
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. May satisfy a Quest requiring surveyed or investigated Locations.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Pages of sketches and careful measurements document the frontier.

Loot Deck.Name: Beacon Crystal
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Required when a Quest states the Fallen Watchtower Beacon needs its focusing crystal.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A faceted crystal shaped to fit the tower's ancient mechanism.

Loot Deck.Name: Ancient Totem
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Used to activate or restore a nature-themed shrine when instructed.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A weathered wooden figure carved with roots and antlers.

Loot Deck.Name: Corrupted Idol
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. May be purified, destroyed, or delivered as directed by a Quest.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Black veins pulse across what was once a holy carving.

Loot Deck.Name: Moon Shrine Relic
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Unlocks a Moon Shrine interaction or objective when referenced.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A silver disc etched with phases of the moon.

Loot Deck.Name: World Fragment
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Campaign-specific fragment required for a major story objective; cannot be voluntarily discarded.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The shard feels impossibly old and faintly vibrates in your palm.

Loot Deck.Name: Bandit Ledger
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Counts as evidence for a bandit or smuggling objective.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Names and payments connect thieves to respectable merchants.

Loot Deck.Name: Noble Signet Ring
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Proves the identity or allegiance of its former owner when a story interaction calls for it.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The ring bears a crest almost worn away by time.

Loot Deck.Name: Lost Family Heirloom
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Return to its owner when instructed to gain the listed Quest reward.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A tiny portrait sits behind cracked glass.

Loot Deck.Name: Ancient Banner
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. May be used to rally allies or complete a historic-site objective when instructed.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Faded colors still show the emblem of a forgotten legion.

Loot Deck.Name: Hero's Writ
Loot Deck.Effect: Quest Item. Authorizes the Heroes to begin or access the next Campaign chapter when instructed.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Stonebrook's leaders have placed their trust in the bearer.

Loot Deck.Name: Explorer's Compass
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. Once per round after you draw a valid Exploration card, you may discard it and draw the next valid Exploration card instead.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Its needle points toward opportunity rather than north.

Loot Deck.Name: Lantern of the First Watch
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. Heroes at your Location ignore Dark and the first Ambush modifier applied there each round.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The blue-white flame has burned without oil for centuries.

Loot Deck.Name: Cartographer's Journal
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. The first time your party reveals a new Location each Scenario, gain 10 Gold.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Every blank page seems eager to be filled.

Loot Deck.Name: Crown of the Forgotten King
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. After completing a Main Quest, gain +1 additional Reputation if that Quest awards Reputation.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A vanished kingdom still commands respect through this crown.

Loot Deck.Name: Ring of the Pathfinder
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. Once per round, your first voluntary Move costs 0 Actions, provided you are not Engaged.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Roads seem shorter while the ring is worn.

Loot Deck.Name: Chalice of Renewal
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. Whenever a Hero at your Location Rests, that Hero recovers 1 additional Health.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Water placed inside becomes cool and perfectly clear.

Loot Deck.Name: Banner of Unity
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. Heroes sharing the bearer's Location gain +1 Attack during their first Attack each round.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: No army ever broke ranks beneath these colors.

Loot Deck.Name: Priest's Reliquary
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. Your Attacks deal +1 damage to Undead or Corrupted enemies after Armor is applied.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Tiny bones and silver script rest behind crystal panes.

Loot Deck.Name: Saint's Icon
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. Once per Scenario, remove all negative Conditions from one Hero at your Location.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The worn icon has been carried through wars, plagues, and worse.

Loot Deck.Name: Tome of Forgotten Lore
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. After you Explore, you may look at the top card of the Exploration Deck and leave it on top or place it on the bottom.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Knowledge erased from history survives between these covers.

Loot Deck.Name: Heart of the Mountain
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. While carried, the bearer gains +1 Armor. A Hero may carry only one Relic that directly grants Armor.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The stone beats slowly against the palm like a distant drum.

Loot Deck.Name: Dragonfire Ember
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. Once per round, after your Attack deals at least 1 damage, deal 1 additional damage to that target.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The ember has not cooled since the age of dragons.

Loot Deck.Name: Worldroot Seed
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. Once per Scenario, each Hero at your Location recovers 2 Health.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Life waits patiently inside the seed.

Loot Deck.Name: Shard of the Ascendant
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. At the start of each Main Quest, gain 1 Ascendance Token if the Campaign uses Ascendance Tokens; otherwise draw 1 Hero card.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Reality seems thinner along the shard's edges.

Loot Deck.Name: Orb of Ages
Loot Deck.Effect: Relic. Once per Scenario at the end of your turn, immediately take another Hero turn. You cannot use Orb of Ages during that extra turn.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Inside the orb, moments repeat before they happen.

Loot Deck.Name: Crown of the First King
Loot Deck.Effect: Legendary Treasure. Gain +2 Reputation when acquired and unlock Campaign options that specifically require the Crown of the First King.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The realm's first crown still carries the weight of authority.

Loot Deck.Name: Heart of the World Tree
Loot Deck.Effect: Legendary Treasure. Once per Scenario, all Heroes recover 3 Health and each removes 1 negative Condition.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A living pulse travels through roots that touch every forest.

Loot Deck.Name: Dragonlord's Hoard
Loot Deck.Effect: Legendary Treasure. When acquired, gain 500 Gold and draw 2 Trade Goods. Then record this Treasure in the Campaign Log.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Centuries of tribute glitter beneath scorched stone.

Loot Deck.Name: Blade of the Ascendant
Loot Deck.Effect: Legendary Treasure. Unlock the unique Blade of the Ascendant Equipment or crafting recipe defined by the Campaign.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The unfinished blade seems to wait for a worthy hand.

Loot Deck.Name: Eternal Forge Ember
Loot Deck.Effect: Legendary Treasure. While owned by the party, Legendary-tier Blacksmithing recipes may be crafted when all other requirements are met.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The final coal from a forge said to predate the kingdom.

Loot Deck.Name: Orb of the Celestial Gate
Loot Deck.Effect: Legendary Treasure. Unlock hidden Locations or future Campaign content that specifically references the Celestial Gate.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Stars not found in the night sky drift beneath its surface.

Loot Deck.Name: Phoenix Heart
Loot Deck.Effect: Legendary Treasure. Once per Campaign when a Hero would be Defeated, discard or mark this Treasure spent to restore that Hero to full Health instead.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The flame inside dies only to ignite again.

Loot Deck.Name: Codex of Eternity
Loot Deck.Effect: Legendary Treasure. Unlock all Campaign recipes or interactions specifically marked Advanced Enchanting.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Every forgotten spell seems to have left a shadow on its pages.

Loot Deck.Name: Crystal of Creation
Loot Deck.Effect: Legendary Treasure. Once per crafting recipe, this may satisfy one required Rare or Epic Crafting Material. It is not consumed unless the recipe says otherwise.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Possibility itself appears frozen inside the crystal.

Loot Deck.Name: Ascendant Keystone
Loot Deck.Effect: Legendary Treasure. Record it when the Campaign finale is completed; future Campaign content may require the Ascendant Keystone to unlock.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The final key is heavier than stone and warmer than blood.

Loot Deck.Name: Black Wax Seal
Loot Deck.Effect: Campaign II evidence. Possession confirms that the road killings and Valewatch murders share the same crown-marked organization. Return/remove only when a Quest or Campaign effect instructs.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The wax is almost black. Pressed into it is a crown no herald recognizes.

Loot Deck.Name: Witness Testimony
Loot Deck.Effect: During WE006, ignore the first Suspicion marker that would be placed each Quest. This is Campaign information, not a sellable Item.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The witness remembers a face, a voice, and the door the killer used.

Loot Deck.Name: Quiet Crown Ledger
Loot Deck.Effect: Record Quiet Crown Supply Network Destroyed. During Q021, remove the first non-Boss Cult reinforcement that would spawn.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Names, payments, warehouse numbers, and coded deliveries fill every page.

Loot Deck.Name: Royal Seal of the First King
Loot Deck.Effect: At the start of Q024, remove 1 Crown Ward before play begins. The Seal remains a Campaign Quest Item unless the finale instructs otherwise.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The old king's signet bears no crown—only a hand closing around one.

Loot Deck.Name: Veiled Crown Fragment
Loot Deck.Effect: Gain only if the final fate of the Veiled Crown leaves a recoverable fragment. Its future effect is not yet defined; record it as a persistent Campaign Relic.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The fragment reflects a face that is never quite the one holding it.

Loot Deck.Name: Warden's Signet
Loot Deck.Effect: Campaign reward marker for Wardens of Valewatch. While Valewatch remains friendly, the party is recognized as trusted defenders and may access services gated by that title.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The city's seal is set beneath a narrow silver warding rune.

Loot Deck.Name: Deepdelver Survey Map
Loot Deck.Effect: During Q027, ignore the first route-gating or blocked-connection effect created by that Quest and one Relay Anchor begins with 1 damage. Future Campaign III Quests may reference Survey Network Restored separately.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Torren's team mapped passages that should not exist beneath the official mine plans.

Loot Deck.Name: Ember Relay Core
Loot Deck.Effect: Campaign III evidence. Records that the party recovered a functioning fragment of the first Worldforge relay. It cannot be sold. Future WE010–WE012 Quests may use it to identify, disable, or safely interface with Worldforge machinery.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The metal stays warm after the furnace goes dark, pulsing once every few seconds like a second heart.

Loot Deck.Name: Clan Key of Emberdeep
Loot Deck.Effect: During Q030, remove 1 Chain Lock before the Chain Relay encounter begins. During Q035, the first Pursuit spawn may be ignored if the Quest permits. The Key remains a persistent Campaign III Quest Item.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The heavy key is cut with teeth on every side, meant for a lock built into an entire wall.

Loot Deck.Name: Heartstone Regulator
Loot Deck.Effect: During Q033, ignore the first Forge Surge damage each Round. At the start of Q036, one Mountain Ward begins with 1 damage. The Regulator is not consumed unless a later effect says otherwise.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A ring of silvered stone hums softly when held near the Mountain Heart's pulse.

Loot Deck.Name: Worldforge Master Key
Loot Deck.Effect: During Q035, L122 Worldforge Core may be revealed after 3 qualifying Heartshaft/Forge Locations instead of 4. At L118 Ancient Lift, the printed Core Lift ability may use this Key. Cannot be sold.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The key has no teeth. The Worldforge recognizes the pattern of heat moving through it.

Loot Deck.Name: Heartwarden Sigil
Loot Deck.Effect: Campaign reward marker for Heartwardens of Ironhaven. While Ironhaven remains allied, the party is recognized as protectors of the Ironspine and may access future services or story options gated by that title.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A red stone set in black iron beats faintly once when its bearer enters the mountains.

Loot Deck.Name: Bloomward Tonic Formula
Loot Deck.Effect: Record First Cure Distilled if Nemi is saved. The first Spore/Poison Hazard in Q039 is ignored. Future Campaign IV effects may reference the formula; it cannot be sold.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The ink changes color when held near Blight.

Loot Deck.Name: Blightheart Sample
Loot Deck.Effect: Proof that the Blight is being cultivated through directed root growth. During WE014, once per Quest after inspecting a Blight Patch, the party may identify whether it is natural or Thorned Circle-created if relevant.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The sample continues growing after being sealed in glass.

Loot Deck.Name: Thornsigil
Loot Deck.Effect: During Q042, remove 1 Thorn Ward before the boss encounter begins. Future Thorned Circle gates may recognize the sigil if specified.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The sigil is a loop of living thorn that never pierces its holder.

Loot Deck.Name: Heartseed Ward
Loot Deck.Effect: During Q045, one Feeding Root begins with 1 damage. During Q048, one Bloom Root begins with 1 damage. Once per Round during WE015, cancel one Hollow Pressure loss of a beneficial Status if the Quest permits.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The ward is a seed that glows when a spirit is near.

Loot Deck.Name: Heartseed Core
Loot Deck.Effect: Records that the Green Cathedral's feeding network was severed. During Q047, ignore the first Choked route penalty encountered by the party. During Q048, after all Bloom Roots are destroyed, one Hero may recover 2 Health.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The core beats once, then waits for another root to answer.

Loot Deck.Name: Verdant Warden Sigil
Loot Deck.Effect: Campaign reward marker for Wardens of the Verdant Reach. While Eldergrove remains allied, future regional services and story options may recognize this title.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A living-leaf sigil stays green even away from sunlight.

Loot Deck.Name: Tideglass Chart
Loot Deck.Effect: During Q051 ignore the first Flood Marker placed and one Bell Lock begins with 1 damage. Future Storm Coast route effects may reference the chart.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The coastline etched on the glass changes with the tide.

Loot Deck.Name: Bellbreaker Key
Loot Deck.Effect: During Q054 remove 1 Choir Bell before setup. May unlock specific Drowned Bell/ritual gates when explicitly stated.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The key rings softly when no bell is moving.

Loot Deck.Name: Ghost Fleet Pennant
Loot Deck.Effect: Q054 cancel first Ghost/Drowned reinforcement. Q059 ignore first Pursuit/Descent spawn. Cannot be sold.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The torn pennant is dry even underwater.

Loot Deck.Name: Beacon Lens
Loot Deck.Effect: Q057 one Chain Anchor begins with 1 damage. Q060 ignore one Tempest Pressure roll/effect each Round where legal.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A shard of daylight remains trapped inside the lens.

Loot Deck.Name: Leviathan Chain Sigil
Loot Deck.Effect: Q059 Deepheart Gate may unlock after 2 qualifying route Locations instead of 3. Q060 one Deep Chain begins with 1 damage.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The sigil is stamped into metal designed to restrain a god-sized creature.

Loot Deck.Name: Stormwarden Sigil
Loot Deck.Effect: Campaign reward marker for Stormwardens of Ashenport. Future Storm Coast services/story may recognize this title.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A silver wave curls around a black stormglass stone.

Loot Deck.Name: Sunscar Wayglass
Loot Deck.Effect: During Q063 ignore the first Mirage Marker and one Solar Seal begins with 1 damage. Future Sunscar route effects may reference the Wayglass.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The glass shows the true road as a dark line through false horizons.

Loot Deck.Name: Crownshard of Dawn
Loot Deck.Effect: Represents recovered Crownshards. Q064/Q066 story and objective text may reference possession; cannot be sold or discarded except by explicit finale choice.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Warm light moves beneath the metal like blood.

Loot Deck.Name: Oasis Covenant Seal
Loot Deck.Effect: Q066 remove 1 Mirror Ward before setup. Q071 ignore the first Mirage/Heat route tax. Q069 cancel first reinforcement if explicitly allowed.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The seal is cool even under the noon sun.

Loot Deck.Name: First Dawn Prism
Loot Deck.Effect: Q069 one Eclipse Anchor begins with 1 damage. Q072 cancel one Eclipse Pressure recovery reduction each Round when legal.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: Inside the prism is the color of sunrise before the eclipse.

Loot Deck.Name: Black Sun Key
Loot Deck.Effect: Q071 Crown Chamber may unlock after 3 qualifying route Locations instead of 4. Q072 may recognize the Key for one explicit gate/ward interaction.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: The key's shadow is brighter than the key itself.

Loot Deck.Name: Dawnbearer Sigil
Loot Deck.Effect: Campaign reward marker for Dawnbearers of Sunspire and completion of the initial six-campaign saga. Future content may recognize the title and recorded Crown outcome.
Loot Deck.Flavor Text: A sunburst surrounds a crown split into three possible futures.

Search Deck.Name: Hidden Cache
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Loot card.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A loose stone reveals a small cache hidden by a traveler long ago.

Search Deck.Name: Forgotten Coin Purse
Search Deck.Effect: Gain 15 Gold.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Someone fled in a hurry and never returned for their coin.

Search Deck.Name: Abandoned Pack
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Loot card. Then discard 1 card from your hand or lose 5 Gold.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The pack is useful, but something has already chewed through half its contents.

Search Deck.Name: Old Supply Crate
Search Deck.Effect: Gain 20 Gold or draw 1 Loot card.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The lid creaks open on supplies that somehow escaped the looters.

Search Deck.Name: Weathered Map
Search Deck.Effect: Reveal 1 unrevealed Location connected to your current Location. Do not resolve its Reveal Effect until it is entered or otherwise revealed normally.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Faded ink still marks a path through the wilderness.

Search Deck.Name: Forgotten Trail Marker
Search Deck.Effect: Look at one unrevealed connected Location. You may leave it unrevealed.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A nearly invisible carving points toward an older route.

Search Deck.Name: Buried Strongbox
Search Deck.Effect: Gain 30 Gold and draw 1 Loot card.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Rust covers the lock, but not the coins inside.

Search Deck.Name: Hunter's Cache
Search Deck.Effect: Recover 1 Health and draw 1 Loot card.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Dried meat and bandages remain wrapped in waxed cloth.

Search Deck.Name: Lost Weapon Bundle
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Equipment card. You may keep it if its rarity is Common or Uncommon; otherwise place it on the bottom of the Equipment deck and gain 25 Gold.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A torn military wrap conceals a weapon still fit for battle.

Search Deck.Name: Traveler's Journal
Search Deck.Effect: Look at the top 2 Exploration cards. Put them back in any order.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The final page describes what the traveler found just ahead.

Search Deck.Name: Collapsed Cart
Search Deck.Effect: Gain 10 Gold and draw 1 Loot card.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: One wheel lies downstream. The cargo did not travel as far.

Search Deck.Name: Hidden Compartment
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 2 Loot cards; keep 1 and discard the other.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A false panel gives way beneath your fingers.

Search Deck.Name: Ancient Coin
Search Deck.Effect: Gain 25 Gold. If the current Location has Ancient, Sacred, or Ruins among its traits or keywords, gain 10 additional Gold.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The face stamped into the coin belongs to no living king.

Search Deck.Name: Smuggler's Stash
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Loot card and gain 25 Gold. Then draw 1 Travel Encounter.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Someone hid these goods because something dangerous was nearby.

Search Deck.Name: Discarded Rations
Search Deck.Effect: Each Hero in this Location may recover 1 Health.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The food is stale, but still edible.

Search Deck.Name: Makeshift Bedroll
Search Deck.Effect: Remove 1 negative Condition from the exploring Hero.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A few quiet minutes are enough to steady shaking hands.

Search Deck.Name: Old Battlefield Spoils
Search Deck.Effect: Choose: gain 30 Gold, or draw 1 Equipment card and keep it only if Common.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Broken weapons litter the ground, but not all are beyond repair.

Search Deck.Name: Hidden Alcove
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Loot card. This Explore does not trigger any additional Encounter unless the card specifically says so.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The narrow recess is invisible from the main passage.

Search Deck.Name: Forgotten Armory
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 2 Equipment cards. Keep 1 Common or Uncommon card and place the other card(s) on the bottom of the deck. If neither qualifies, gain 30 Gold.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Dust covers the racks, but steel survives longer than kingdoms.

Search Deck.Name: Shrine Offering
Search Deck.Effect: Choose one Hero in this Location: recover 2 Health or remove 1 negative Condition.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A small offering bowl remains untouched beneath the cracked idol.

Search Deck.Name: Old Ranger Signal
Search Deck.Effect: Reveal 1 connected unrevealed Location. If it is a Goblin Structure, Goblin Camp, or Fortress, draw 1 Loot card.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Three cuts in the bark warn of danger ahead.

Search Deck.Name: Secret Footpath
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero may immediately Move to one connected revealed Location without spending an Action, if not Engaged.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A narrow deer trail cuts around the worst of the terrain.

Search Deck.Name: Crumbling Wall Niche
Search Deck.Effect: Gain 15 Gold. On a Location with Ancient or Ruins, also draw 1 Loot card.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A mason's hollow hides more than mortar.

Search Deck.Name: Forgotten Memorial
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Hero card. If your hand has 5 or fewer cards after drawing, recover 1 Health.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Names carved into stone remind you what is at stake.

Search Deck.Name: Abandoned Goblin Satchel
Search Deck.Effect: Gain 20 Gold. You may look at the top Encounter card and place it on the top or bottom of the Encounter Deck.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The satchel contains coins, crude maps, and a list of patrol routes.

Search Deck.Name: Hidden Grotto
Search Deck.Effect: Recover 2 Health. Then look at the top Exploration card; you may discard it.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Behind the spray lies a quiet pool untouched by the fighting.

Search Deck.Name: Forgotten Key
Search Deck.Effect: Keep this card. Discard it to ignore one Locked, Sealed, Gate, or Trap restriction that would otherwise require an Action or test.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The iron key is old enough to fit locks no one remembers making.

Search Deck.Name: Sealed Coffer
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 2 Loot cards and gain 25 Gold.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The coffer's seal breaks with a satisfying snap.

Search Deck.Name: Stolen Village Goods
Search Deck.Effect: Gain 25 Gold and draw 1 Loot card. If Stonebrook is currently under a Quest attack, gain 10 additional Gold.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Marks on the crates show they were taken from Stonebrook.

Search Deck.Name: Rare Find
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Equipment card. You may keep it regardless of rarity.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: For once, fortune favors the bold.

Search Deck.Name: Moment of Calm
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero may draw 1 Hero card or recover 1 Health.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: For a brief moment, the world goes quiet.

Search Deck.Name: Clear Vantage Point
Search Deck.Effect: Look at up to 2 unrevealed Locations connected to the current Location. Return them unrevealed.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: From here, the paths ahead are easier to read.

Search Deck.Name: Useful Shortcut
Search Deck.Effect: The next Move Action taken by the exploring Hero this turn costs 0 Actions.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A narrow cut through the terrain saves precious time.

Search Deck.Name: Fresh Water
Search Deck.Effect: Recover 2 Health or remove Poisoned from the exploring Hero.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Cold water washes away blood and exhaustion.

Search Deck.Name: Medicinal Herbs
Search Deck.Effect: Remove Poisoned or Bleeding from one Hero in this Location. If neither applies, recover 1 Health.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The leaves are bitter, but their purpose is unmistakable.

Search Deck.Name: Safe Campsite
Search Deck.Effect: Each Hero in this Location may recover 1 Health. No Hero may Explore this Location again this round.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A ring of stones and dry ground makes a rare safe resting place.

Search Deck.Name: Old Watcher's Perch
Search Deck.Effect: Look at the top 3 Exploration cards. Put them back in any order.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Someone once watched these roads for exactly the same reasons.

Search Deck.Name: Favorable Ground
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero gains Guard.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The terrain offers a position worth defending.

Search Deck.Name: Inspirational Relic
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero gains Inspired until the end of their next turn.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A small symbol of courage survives in the dust.

Search Deck.Name: Hidden Cover
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero gains Guard. If already Guarded, draw 1 Hero card instead.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A fallen wall or thick trunk provides a moment of safety.

Search Deck.Name: Trail Signs
Search Deck.Effect: Look at the top Encounter card. You may place it on the bottom of the Encounter Deck.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Broken branches and boot marks tell a story to anyone willing to read them.

Search Deck.Name: Goblin Patrol Schedule
Search Deck.Effect: The next Travel Encounter drawn this round has -1 Severity, minimum 1.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Crude scratches list patrol times with surprising precision.

Search Deck.Name: Prepared Position
Search Deck.Effect: Until the end of the round, Heroes in this Location gain +1 Armor against the first attack that damages them.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Old defenses can still be useful when turned the right direction.

Search Deck.Name: Lucky Break
Search Deck.Effect: Take 1 additional Action this turn.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Sometimes the path simply opens at the right moment.

Search Deck.Name: Quiet Discovery
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Hero card. This Exploration card is then placed on the bottom of the Exploration Deck instead of the discard pile.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Nothing dramatic—just one useful detail you almost missed.

Search Deck.Name: Hidden Snare
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero becomes Rooted until the end of their turn.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The loop tightens around your ankle before you see the rope.

Search Deck.Name: Loose Stones
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero suffers 1 damage that ignores Armor.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Pebbles become a sudden shower of sharp rock.

Search Deck.Name: Poisonous Spores
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero gains Poisoned.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A pale cloud bursts from the disturbed growth.

Search Deck.Name: Rotten Floorboards
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero suffers 1 damage and loses 1 remaining Action, if any.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The floor gives way exactly where it looked strongest.

Search Deck.Name: Goblin Trap
Search Deck.Effect: Suffer 1 damage that ignores Armor, then draw 1 Travel Encounter.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The trap was never meant to kill you. It was meant to make noise.

Search Deck.Name: Falling Debris
Search Deck.Effect: Each Hero in this Location suffers 1 damage.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A low rumble becomes a cascade of dust and stone.

Search Deck.Name: Sudden Flood
Search Deck.Effect: Each Hero in this Location becomes Slowed until the end of their next turn.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Water surges through the low ground without warning.

Search Deck.Name: Webbed Passage
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero becomes Rooted. They may spend 1 Action to remove Rooted immediately.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Sticky strands wrap around boots and weapons.

Search Deck.Name: Unstable Ground
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero cannot Move again this turn unless a card or ability grants Forced Movement.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The earth shifts beneath your weight.

Search Deck.Name: Burning Embers
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero gains Burning.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A hidden coal flares when disturbed.

Search Deck.Name: Cursed Trinket
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero becomes Weakened until they Rest or an effect removes the Condition. Then draw 1 Loot card.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The object feels valuable right up until you touch it.

Search Deck.Name: False Cache
Search Deck.Effect: Gain 10 Gold, then immediately draw 1 Travel Encounter.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The bait is real. So is the ambush.

Search Deck.Name: Cave-In
Search Deck.Effect: Place a Rubble marker on this Location. The next Hero to Move out of this Location must use 1 additional Move Action; then remove the marker.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The passage behind you disappears beneath falling stone.

Search Deck.Name: Stinging Swarm
Search Deck.Effect: The exploring Hero suffers 1 damage and cannot recover Health until the end of their turn.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A black cloud rises from the brush.

Search Deck.Name: Alarm Bell
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter at +1 Severity.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A crude bell begins ringing before you can silence it.

Search Deck.Name: Fresh Goblin Tracks
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Fresh footprints cross the path, accompanied by the drag marks of stolen supplies.

Search Deck.Name: Arrows in the Bark
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter. If it is an Ambush, increase its Severity by 1.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Several arrows are buried in the trees ahead.

Search Deck.Name: Distant War Horn
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter at +1 Severity.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: A horn answers another somewhere beyond the ridge.

Search Deck.Name: Predator Signs
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter. If it is a Beast encounter, the Heroes gain 10 Gold after resolving it.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Tracks circle the area instead of passing through it.

Search Deck.Name: Goblin Campfire Smoke
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter. If it contains Goblins, gain 10 Gold after resolving it.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: Thin smoke rises above the trees.

Search Deck.Name: Broken Barricade
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter. Reduce its Severity by 1, minimum 1.

Search Deck.Name: Frightened Refugee

Search Deck.Flavor Text: They clutch a small bundle and keep looking over their shoulder.

Search Deck.Name: Old Ranger
Search Deck.Effect: Look at up to 2 unrevealed connected Locations. You may reveal one of them without spending an Action.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The ranger knows these woods better than the goblins do.

Search Deck.Name: Lost Merchant
Search Deck.Effect: You may buy one Common Item or Equipment for 10 Gold less than its normal cost, minimum 0.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The merchant insists this was supposed to be the safe road.

Search Deck.Name: Village Scout
Search Deck.Effect: The next Travel Encounter this round has -1 Severity, minimum 1.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The scout quietly points out a safer route.

Search Deck.Name: Goblin Deserter
Search Deck.Effect: Choose: gain 25 Gold for letting the deserter flee, or draw 1 Travel Encounter at -1 Severity and gain 1 Loot after resolving it.

Search Deck.Name: Herbalist

Search Deck.Name: Old Soldier
Search Deck.Effect: One Hero gains Inspired until the end of their next turn.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The veteran has survived enough battles to know exactly what to say.

Search Deck.Name: Treasure Seeker
Search Deck.Effect: Draw 2 Exploration cards. Choose 1 to resolve and discard the other. Do not draw again for terrain mismatch.
Search Deck.Flavor Text: The stranger smiles as if they already know where the good stuff is.

Search Deck.Effect: Gain 10 Gold. If WE001 or WE002 is active, look at the top Encounter card and you may place it on the bottom.

Search Deck.Name: Burned Farmstead

Search Deck.Flavor Text: The ruins are still warm.

Search Deck.Name: Goblin War Plans

Status Effects.Name: Poisoned
Status Effects.Effect: Suffer 1 damage at the start of your activation.
Status Effects.Removal: Antidote, Purifying Herbs, or another effect removes Poisoned.

Status Effects.Name: Burning
Status Effects.Effect: Suffer 1 damage at the end of your activation.
Status Effects.Removal: Burn Salve, water-related effect, or another effect removes Burning.

Status Effects.Name: Bleeding
Status Effects.Effect: Suffer 1 damage each time you perform an Attack.
Status Effects.Removal: Rest, Bandage Roll, Herbal Poultice, or another effect removes Bleeding.

Status Effects.Name: Stunned
Status Effects.Effect: Immediately end your activation if currently activating. You cannot perform Actions or activate.
Status Effects.Duration: Until the end of your next activation.
Status Effects.Removal: Expires automatically or another effect removes Stunned.

Status Effects.Name: Rooted
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot voluntarily Move. Other Actions are unaffected.

Status Effects.Name: Slowed
Status Effects.Effect: Lose 1 Action during your activation, minimum 1 Action.

Status Effects.Name: Weakened
Status Effects.Effect: Your Attack is reduced by 1.
Status Effects.Removal: Restorative Tonic or another effect removes Weakened.

Status Effects.Name: Vulnerable
Status Effects.Effect: Your Armor is reduced by 1, minimum 0.

Status Effects.Name: Guarded
Status Effects.Effect: Gain +1 Armor.
Status Effects.Removal: Another effect removes Guarded or its source ends.

Status Effects.Name: Inspired
Status Effects.Effect: Gain +1 Attack.
Status Effects.Removal: Another effect removes Inspired or its source ends.

Status Effects.Name: Hidden
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot be targeted by attacks unless the attacker is in your Location or another rule specifically allows it.
Status Effects.Duration: Until you Attack or another effect removes Hidden.
Status Effects.Removal: Attack or another effect removes Hidden.

Status Effects.Name: Regenerating
Status Effects.Effect: Recover 1 Health at the start of your activation.

Status Effects.Name: Exhausted
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot benefit from abilities that grant additional Actions.
Status Effects.Duration: Until the end of your next activation.

Status Effects.Name: Flying
Status Effects.Effect: Ignore terrain restrictions and may cross obstacles as allowed by Scenario rules.
Status Effects.Removal: Only another effect can remove Flying.

Status Effects.Name: Ethereal
Status Effects.Effect: You may move through units and terrain that would normally block movement, subject to card text.
Status Effects.Duration: As specified by the granting effect.
Status Effects.Removal: As specified by the granting effect.

Status Effects.Name: Knocked Down
Status Effects.Effect: Your first Action on your turn must be spent to Stand. While Knocked Down, you cannot voluntarily Move.
Status Effects.Removal: Spend 1 Action to Stand or another effect removes it.

Status Effects.Name: Grappled
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot voluntarily Move away from the source of Grappled.
Status Effects.Duration: Until the source leaves, is Defeated, or the effect is removed.
Status Effects.Removal: Defeat/leave source or another effect removes Grappled.

Status Effects.Name: Restrained
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot Move and your Attack is reduced by 1.

Status Effects.Name: Disarmed
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot use your equipped Weapon's Attack bonus or Weapon abilities.
Status Effects.Duration: Until the end of your next turn.
Status Effects.Removal: Expires automatically or another effect restores the Weapon.

Status Effects.Name: Crippled
Status Effects.Effect: Your Move Action costs 1 additional Action.

Status Effects.Name: Dazed
Status Effects.Effect: The next Action you perform costs 1 additional Action.
Status Effects.Duration: Until triggered or end of turn.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed after the increased cost is paid or at end of turn.

Status Effects.Name: Silenced
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot use abilities with the Arcane, Spell, Prayer, or Chant keyword.

Status Effects.Name: Blinded
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot target enemies outside your current Location.

Status Effects.Name: Marked
Status Effects.Effect: The source of Marked gains +1 Attack when attacking you.
Status Effects.Duration: Until the source's next turn ends.
Status Effects.Removal: Expires automatically or source leaves play.

Status Effects.Name: Taunted
Status Effects.Effect: If able, your next Attack must target the unit that applied Taunted.
Status Effects.Duration: Until you make an Attack or source leaves play.
Status Effects.Removal: Attack the source or another effect removes Taunted.

Status Effects.Name: Frightened
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot voluntarily Move closer to the source of Frightened.
Status Effects.Duration: Until the end of your next turn.
Status Effects.Removal: Expires automatically or another effect removes Frightened.

Status Effects.Name: Confused
Status Effects.Effect: At the start of your turn, roll 1d6. On 1-2, lose 1 Action; on 3-6, no effect.

Status Effects.Name: Charmed
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot target the source with Attacks or harmful abilities.
Status Effects.Duration: Until source is Defeated or effect ends.
Status Effects.Removal: Defeat source, source leaves play, or another effect removes Charmed.

Status Effects.Name: Panicked
Status Effects.Effect: Your first voluntary Action must be Move away from the nearest hostile unit if legal.
Status Effects.Duration: Until the end of your next turn.

Status Effects.Name: Shaken
Status Effects.Effect: Your first Attack each round suffers -1 Attack.
Status Effects.Removal: Rest or another effect removes Shaken.

Status Effects.Name: Pinned
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot voluntarily Move from your Location while a hostile Ranged enemy with line of effect remains able to attack you.
Status Effects.Duration: Until that condition is no longer true.
Status Effects.Removal: Break line of effect, defeat source, or another effect removes Pinned.

Status Effects.Name: Suppressed
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot gain free Move or free Attack Actions.
Status Effects.Duration: Until the end of the round.

Status Effects.Name: Staggered
Status Effects.Effect: Your next Attack suffers -1 Attack.

Status Effects.Name: Cracked Armor
Status Effects.Effect: Your Armor is reduced by 1.
Status Effects.Removal: Repair effect or another effect removes Cracked Armor.

Status Effects.Name: Corroded
Status Effects.Effect: Your Armor is reduced by 1 and cannot be increased above its printed value.
Status Effects.Removal: Cleaning, repair, or another effect removes Corroded.

Status Effects.Name: Wet
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot gain Burning. Lightning effects against you deal +1 damage if their text checks Wet.
Status Effects.Duration: Until end of round or removed.
Status Effects.Removal: Expires at end of round or another effect removes Wet.

Status Effects.Name: Chilled
Status Effects.Effect: Your first Move each turn costs 1 additional Action.
Status Effects.Duration: Until end of your next turn.
Status Effects.Removal: Expires automatically or another effect removes Chilled.

Status Effects.Name: Frozen
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot Move or perform free Move effects.
Status Effects.Duration: Until end of your next activation.
Status Effects.Removal: Expires automatically or a Fire effect removes Frozen.

Status Effects.Name: Shocked
Status Effects.Effect: The next time you would gain an additional Action, do not gain it.
Status Effects.Duration: Until triggered or end of round.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed when it prevents an Action gain or at end of round.

Status Effects.Name: Electrified
Status Effects.Effect: The next time you become Wet or take Lightning damage, suffer 1 additional damage.
Status Effects.Duration: Until triggered or end of round.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed when triggered or at end of round.

Status Effects.Name: Scorched
Status Effects.Effect: You recover 1 less Health from the next recovery effect that affects you, minimum 0.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed after reducing one recovery effect.

Status Effects.Name: Cursed
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot remove other harmful Conditions unless the removing effect also removes Cursed or says it ignores Cursed.

Status Effects.Name: Hexed
Status Effects.Effect: The first die you roll each turn is rolled twice; use the lower result.

Status Effects.Name: Mana Burn
Status Effects.Effect: When you play a card with an Arcane keyword, suffer 1 damage.
Status Effects.Removal: Rest or another effect removes Mana Burn.

Status Effects.Name: Withered
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot recover more than 1 Health from a single effect.

Status Effects.Name: Diseased
Status Effects.Effect: Recovery effects restore 1 less Health, minimum 0.

Status Effects.Name: Infected
Status Effects.Effect: At the end of each Scenario, if still Infected, suffer the Campaign penalty specified by the source.

Status Effects.Name: Fortified
Status Effects.Effect: Gain +1 Armor against the first Attack that damages you each round.
Status Effects.Removal: Source ends or another effect removes Fortified.

Status Effects.Name: Protected
Status Effects.Effect: Reduce the next damage you suffer by 1, then remove Protected.

Status Effects.Name: Barrier
Status Effects.Effect: Prevent the next 2 damage you would suffer, then remove Barrier.

Status Effects.Name: Ward
Status Effects.Effect: Ignore the next harmful Condition that would be applied to you, then remove Ward.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed when it prevents a Condition.

Status Effects.Name: Blessed
Status Effects.Effect: Your first Attack each round gains +1 Attack.
Status Effects.Removal: Source ends or another effect removes Blessed.

Status Effects.Name: Consecrated
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot gain Cursed or Hexed.
Status Effects.Removal: Leave source or another effect removes it.

Status Effects.Name: Empowered
Status Effects.Effect: Your next Attack gains +2 Attack.

Status Effects.Name: Focused
Status Effects.Effect: Ignore the next -1 Attack penalty applied to you, then remove Focused.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed after preventing one Attack penalty.

Status Effects.Name: Hasted
Status Effects.Effect: Gain 1 additional Action at the start of your turn.
Status Effects.Duration: Until end of your next turn.

Status Effects.Name: Quickened
Status Effects.Effect: Your next Move Action costs 0 Actions.
Status Effects.Duration: Until triggered or end of turn.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed after Move or at end of turn.

Status Effects.Name: Unstoppable
Status Effects.Effect: Ignore the next Rooted, Knocked Down, Grappled, or Restrained effect applied to you, then remove Unstoppable.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed when it prevents one listed Condition.

Status Effects.Name: Steadfast
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot gain Frightened, Panicked, or Shaken.
Status Effects.Removal: Source ends or another effect removes Steadfast.

Status Effects.Name: Resolute
Status Effects.Effect: The first time you would be reduced to 0 Health, remain at 1 Health instead, then remove Resolute.

Status Effects.Name: Vigilant
Status Effects.Effect: The first enemy that enters your Location each round satisfies enemy-entry Reaction triggers you possess.

Status Effects.Name: Prepared
Status Effects.Effect: The next Interact, Explore, or Rest Action you perform costs 0 Actions.
Status Effects.Duration: Until triggered or end of turn.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed after use or at end of turn.

Status Effects.Name: Camouflaged
Status Effects.Effect: Ranged enemies outside your Location cannot target you.
Status Effects.Duration: Until you Attack, enter a Settlement, or effect removes it.
Status Effects.Removal: Attack, enter Settlement, or another effect removes Camouflaged.

Status Effects.Name: Entrenched
Status Effects.Effect: While you remain in your current Location, gain +1 Armor.

Status Effects.Name: Elevated
Status Effects.Effect: Your Ranged Attacks gain +1 Range if their normal Range is at least 1 connected Location.

Status Effects.Name: Regrouped
Status Effects.Effect: The next time you Rest, recover 1 additional Health and draw 1 Hero card.

Status Effects.Name: Rallied
Status Effects.Effect: If an allied Hero shares your Location, gain +1 Attack on your first Attack each turn.
Status Effects.Removal: Source ends or no ally shares your Location.

Status Effects.Name: Linked
Status Effects.Effect: Choose another Hero at your Location. Once per round when either linked Hero gains Guarded or Inspired, the other gains the same Condition.

Status Effects.Name: Shielded
Status Effects.Effect: Gain +2 Armor against the next Attack that targets you, then remove Shielded.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed after next Attack against you.

Status Effects.Name: Braced
Status Effects.Effect: If an enemy Moves into your Location, your next Attack against that enemy this round gains +1 Attack.
Status Effects.Duration: Until triggered or end of round.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed after use or at end of round.

Status Effects.Name: Berserk
Status Effects.Effect: Gain +2 Attack, but your Armor is reduced by 1, minimum 0.

Status Effects.Name: Frenzied
Status Effects.Effect: After you Defeat an enemy, your next Attack this turn gains +1 Attack.
Status Effects.Duration: Until triggered or end of turn.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed after next Attack or at end of turn.

Status Effects.Name: Bloodthirsty
Status Effects.Effect: The first time each turn you Defeat an enemy, recover 1 Health.

Status Effects.Name: Aegis
Status Effects.Effect: Allied Heroes at your Location gain +1 Armor against the first Attack that damages them each round.

Status Effects.Name: Radiant
Status Effects.Effect: Your Attacks against Corrupted or Undead targets deal +1 damage after Armor.

Status Effects.Name: Arcane Shield
Status Effects.Effect: Reduce the next Arcane, Fire, Cold, or Lightning damage you suffer by 2, then remove Arcane Shield.

Status Effects.Name: Fireproof
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot gain Burning and reduce Fire damage you suffer by 1.

Status Effects.Name: Coldproof
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot gain Chilled or Frozen.

Status Effects.Name: Shockproof
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot gain Shocked or Electrified.

Status Effects.Name: Venomproof
Status Effects.Effect: You cannot gain Poisoned.

Status Effects.Name: True Sight
Status Effects.Effect: Ignore Hidden and Camouflaged when determining valid targets.

Status Effects.Name: Surefooted
Status Effects.Effect: Ignore Difficult Terrain and the first additional Move Action required by a terrain-based movement effect each turn.

Status Effects.Name: Fleet
Status Effects.Effect: After your first Move Action each turn, you may Move one additional connected Location if not Engaged.

Status Effects.Name: Evasive
Status Effects.Effect: The first Ranged Attack against you each round deals 1 less damage, minimum 0.

Status Effects.Name: Countering
Status Effects.Effect: The first time each round an enemy damages you with a melee Attack, your next Attack against it gains +1 Attack.

Status Effects.Name: Overwatch
Status Effects.Effect: You are prepared to use Reaction Attacks against hostile units that Move into valid range when another rule grants such a Reaction.

Status Effects.Name: Channeling
Status Effects.Effect: Your next Arcane card or ability costs 1 fewer Action, minimum 0.
Status Effects.Duration: Until triggered or end of turn.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed after use or at end of turn.

Status Effects.Name: Sanctified
Status Effects.Effect: When you gain a harmful Condition, roll 1d6. On a 6, ignore it.

Status Effects.Name: Alerted
Status Effects.Effect: Use aggressive/combat behavior instead of passive or patrol behavior.
Status Effects.Duration: Until no hostile Hero is revealed or Scenario states otherwise.
Status Effects.Removal: Scenario or behavior effect removes Alerted.

Status Effects.Name: Patrolling
Status Effects.Effect: Follow patrol route or Scenario movement instead of pursuing Heroes.
Status Effects.Duration: Until Alerted or Scenario changes state.

Status Effects.Name: Guarding
Status Effects.Effect: Remain within Guard Area and prioritize threats to the protected target.
Status Effects.Duration: Until protected target is gone or behavior changes.

Status Effects.Name: Enraged
Status Effects.Effect: Gain +1 Attack and prioritize the nearest Hero.
Status Effects.Duration: Until end of encounter or source says otherwise.

Status Effects.Name: Retreating
Status Effects.Effect: Prioritize moving toward the designated safe Location and avoid Attacks unless blocked.
Status Effects.Duration: Until reaching safety or behavior changes.

Status Effects.Name: Summoned
Status Effects.Effect: This unit was created by another effect and follows the source's removal rules.

Status Effects.Name: Objective Carrier
Status Effects.Effect: This unit is carrying a Quest Objective. Effects referencing the Objective Carrier apply to it.
Status Effects.Duration: Until objective is dropped, delivered, or removed.

Status Effects.Name: Escorting
Status Effects.Effect: This unit is linked to an Escort objective and follows the Quest or Scenario escort rules.

Status Effects.Name: Tracked
Status Effects.Effect: Effects that reference Tracked targets may locate or target this unit regardless of normal tracking restrictions.

Status Effects.Name: Favored
Status Effects.Effect: A faction considers this Hero or party favored. Campaign effects may unlock benefits tied to Favored.

Status Effects.Name: Cursed Item
Status Effects.Effect: The affected Equipment cannot be voluntarily unequipped unless a rule specifically allows it.

Status Effects.Name: Broken
Status Effects.Effect: The affected Equipment provides no abilities or stat bonuses.

Status Effects.Name: Exposed
Status Effects.Effect: The next Attack made against you gains +1 Attack. Then remove Exposed.
Status Effects.Removal: Removed after the next Attack against you resolves or another effect removes Exposed.

Status Effects.Name: Stealth
Status Effects.Effect: Stealth has no inherent targeting or combat effect by itself. Cards that reference Stealth provide its benefits. Lose Stealth when an effect says to lose or reveal it.
Status Effects.Duration: Until removed by a card or effect.
Status Effects.Removal: A card/effect removes Stealth; resolving an Attack removes it only when that card says so.
